titleByLocale.en: Senior Director of Brand Apparel Marketing

jobs.description:
At a Glance

You are the Senior Director of Apparel Marketing , reporting directly into the CMO. Your mission is to be the direct brand partner to the Creative Director of apparel, inspire teams across On, champion our culture, and be recognized as a guardian of the Apparel brand portfolio and strategic direction, ensuring all Marketing efforts in Apparel align with the main On priorities, influenced by the external global landscape.

• Work Focus: You will define and lead the function-wide brand strategy for Apparel, overseeing multiple complex and strategic initiatives with a core focus on Apparel. This role demands enterprise-level strategic expertise and has a critical, systemic impact throughout On.

• Decision-making: You are experienced at driving high-level decisions, acting as the decision maker for the Apparel Brand Management function and playing a key role in executive decision-making.

• Scope: Projects and initiatives under your direction have a strategic impact on On’s entire portfolio and long-term direction. You collaborate with the C-suite, senior leadership and are a key stakeholder to the Management Team.

• Autonomy: You own the Apparel Brand Management discipline globally, defining operating models and priorities. You are responsible for simplifying complex organizational situations and prioritizing critical work across the enterprise. You play a key role in ensuring synergies across all product categories, marketing channels, and regions.

Your Mission

Your core mission is to elevate the global On brand by architecting the structure, defining the strategy, and leading the talent required to execute our brand promise across all categories.

Set the Enterprise Brand Vision & Governance

• Define the long-term, multi-year architecture for the Apparel Brand Management function, dictating how all category brand leads (including the Head of Brand, Apparel) approach their business to ensure a unified global brand identity.

• Align and secure buy-in from the C-suite and all regional Managing Directors on the overarching brand strategy and resource allocation across major product verticals.

• Simplify and prioritize the complex portfolio of brand initiatives to focus resources on the highest-value opportunities for On’s sustainable growth.

Drive Organizational and Talent Excellence

• Serve as the senior organizational leader who coaches, mentors, and directs the Apparel Brand team to raise the bar on strategic thinking and execution quality. You will also influence and drive

• Architect the global operating model for Apparel Brand management, ensuring clear roles, responsibilities, and decision-making rights between product, marketing, and commercial teams globally.

• Act as the primary interface between the Apparel Brand function and Executive Leadership, communicating the brand strategy, performance, and talent needs.

Measure for Systemic Evolution

• Establish and mandate the key performance indicators (KPIs) and metrics (e.g., brand health, cultural relevance, portfolio value) used across all apparel categories and regions to measure brand success.

• Drive a culture of measurement that informs strategic shifts in product investment, market entry, and commercial priorities at the executive level.

jobs.title: Sample Maker
jobs.description:
Sample Maker Job Summary:
 We are looking for a motivated and detail-oriented Sample Maker with a passion for athletic and ready to wear apparel. In this role, you will be responsible for creating high-quality prototypes, muslins and mockups in partnership with pattern engineers, product development and designers to bring product concepts to life. The ideal candidate has a strong foundation in fabric handling (both cutting and sewing), garment construction and sewing techniques. This person should be self driven and eager to continuously grow their skills in apparel development. This is a 6 month contract with potential for permanent.

Key Responsibilities:

• Construct prototypes based on technical specifications, patterns, and alternative construction methods in collaboration with cross functional teams.

• Determine optimal fabrics, trims, and sewing techniques for high-performance apparel.

• Proactively identify and resolve construction challenges.

• Support prototype-to-production transitions at a premium level.

• Ensure samples meet strict quality standards for stitching, durability, and finish.

• Maintain an organized workspace and efficient workflow.

• Stay current on both athletic and ready to wear industry trends and advanced sewing techniques, specific to appearance and function.

Qualifications & Skills:

Experience:

• 8+ years of experience as a Sample Maker, Sample Sewer, or in a similar role within apparel manufacturing, including employment experience in a factory, sample room, or tailoring shop.

• Demonstrated technical proficiency in handling and sewing complex fabrications, spanning both stretch and non-stretch textiles.

• Advanced experience with sewing athletics and ready to wear garments.

• Understanding of garment construction and pattern interpretation.

Technical Skills:

• Proficiency in using industrial sewing machines (single-needle, overlock, coverstitch, etc.).

• Ability to read and follow patterns, spec sheets, and technical sketches.

• Experience working with all fabrications

• Strong attention to detail and a commitment to quality craftsmanship.

Preferred Qualifications:

• Experience with digital pattern-making software (e.g., Gerber, Lectra) is a plus.

• Basic knowledge of garment dyeing, washing, or textile printing techniques (DTF, DTG).

About the team:

We are focused, solutions-oriented, and able to take action upon imminent challenges. We establish and follow processes, but are also continuously confronting the status quo and the industry standard. We are engineers that steer pinnacle sportswear design ideas into functional reality. We are able to convert innovative concepts and prototypes into commercialised products with stringent quality and engineering standards, bringing them into the hands of our discerning, global customer base. Product creation is a mindset and every team member is empowered to make decisions with the understanding that failure is part of the learning and growth process. As an integrated function in the design and development organisation; we are detail-minded problem solvers; guiding and executing apparel technical development within tight timelines and the highest possible product quality, both on the shelf and in use.

- Rimani aggiornato sia sulle tendenze atletiche che pronte all'uso del settore e sulle tecniche di cucito avanzate, specifiche per l'aspetto e la funzione.

Qualificazioni e competenze

Esperienza - 8+ anni di esperienza come Maker campione, Seminatore campione, o in un ruolo simile nella produzione di abbigliamento, tra cui esperienza di lavoro in una fabbrica, sala campioni, o negozio di sartoria. - Competenza tecnica dimostrativa nella manipolazione e cucito manufatti complessi, spaziando sia tessuti elastici e non elastici. - Esperienza avanzata con l'atletica del cucito e pronto per indossare indumenti. - Comprensione della costruzione di capi e interpretazione del modello.

Capacità tecniche - Professionalità nell'uso di macchine da cucire industriali (ago singolo, overlock, covertitch, ecc.). - Capacità di leggere e seguire modelli, fogli specifici e schizzi tecnici. - Esperienza lavorando con tutte le lavorazioni - Forte attenzione ai dettagli e un impegno per l'artigianato di qualità.

Qualificazioni preferite - L'esperienza con il software digitale di creazione di pattern (ad esempio, Gerber, Lectra) è un plus. - Conoscenza di base di tintura di capi di abbigliamento, lavaggio, o tecniche di stampa tessile (DTF, DGG).

Siamo focalizzati, orientati alle soluzioni e in grado di affrontare sfide imminenti. Stabiliamo e seguiamo i processi, ma stiamo anche affrontando continuamente lo status quo e lo standard del settore. Siamo ingegneri che guidano le idee di design dello sportswear in realtà funzionale. Siamo in grado di convertire concetti e prototipi innovativi in prodotti commercializzati con standard qualitativi e ingegneristici rigorosi, portandoli nelle mani della nostra clientela globale e discreta.

La creazione di prodotti è una mentalità e ogni membro del team è abilitato a prendere decisioni con la consapevolezza che il fallimento è parte del processo di apprendimento e crescita. Come funzione integrata nell'organizzazione di progettazione e sviluppo; siamo risolutori di problemi con una mentalità dettagliata; guida e attuazione dello sviluppo tecnico dell'abbigliamento entro scadenze ravvicinate e la massima qualità possibile del prodotto, sia sullo scaffale che in uso.
descriptionByLocale.en:
Description
We are looking for a motivated and detail-oriented Sample Maker with a passion for athletic and ready to wear apparel. In this role, you will be responsible for creating high-quality prototypes, muslins and mockups in partnership with pattern engineers, product development and designers to bring product concepts to life. The ideal candidate has a strong foundation in fabric handling (both cutting and sewing), garment construction and sewing techniques. This person should be self driven and eager to continuously grow their skills in apparel development. This is a 6 month contract with potential for permanent.

Responsibilities
- Construct prototypes based on technical specifications, patterns, and alternative construction methods in collaboration with cross functional teams.
- Determine optimal fabrics, trims, and sewing techniques for high-performance apparel.
- Proactively identify and resolve construction challenges.
- Support prototype-to-production transitions at a premium level.
- Ensure samples meet strict quality standards for stitching, durability, and finish.
- Maintain an organized workspace and efficient workflow.
- Stay current on both athletic and ready to wear industry trends and advanced sewing techniques, specific to appearance and function.

Qualifications & Skills

Experience
- 8+ years of experience as a Sample Maker, Sample Sewer, or in a similar role within apparel manufacturing, including employment experience in a factory, sample room, or tailoring shop.
- Demonstrated technical proficiency in handling and sewing complex fabrications, spanning both stretch and non-stretch textiles.
- Advanced experience with sewing athletics and ready to wear garments.
- Understanding of garment construction and pattern interpretation.

Technical Skills
- Proficiency in using industrial sewing machines (single-needle, overlock, coverstitch, etc.).
- Ability to read and follow patterns, spec sheets, and technical sketches.
- Experience working with all fabrications
- Strong attention to detail and a commitment to quality craftsmanship.

Preferred Qualifications
- Experience with digital pattern-making software (e.g., Gerber, Lectra) is a plus.
- Basic knowledge of garment dyeing, washing, or textile printing techniques (DTF, DTG).

About the team
We are focused, solutions-oriented, and able to take action upon imminent challenges. We establish and follow processes, but are also continuously confronting the status quo and the industry standard. We are engineers that steer pinnacle sportswear design ideas into functional reality. We are able to convert innovative concepts and prototypes into commercialised products with stringent quality and engineering standards, bringing them into the hands of our discerning, global customer base. Product creation is a mindset and every team member is empowered to make decisions with the understanding that failure is part of the learning and growth process. As an integrated function in the design and development organisation; we are detail-minded problem solvers; guiding and executing apparel technical development within tight timelines and the highest possible product quality, both on the shelf and in use.
descriptionByLocale.de:

Qualifikationen und Fähigkeiten

Technische Fähigkeiten - Kenntnisse in der Verwendung von industriellen Nähmaschinen (Einzelnadel, Overlock, Covertitch, etc.). - Fähigkeit, Mustern, Spec Sheets und technischen Skizzen zu lesen und zu folgen. - Erfahrung mit allen Fabrikationen arbeiten - Starke Liebe zum Detail und ein Engagement für Qualität Handwerk.

Bevorzugte Qualifikationen - Erfahrung mit digitaler Musterbausoftware (z.B. Gerber, Lectra) ist ein Plus. - Grundkenntnisse in der Bekleidungsfärbetechnik, beim Waschen oder Textildruck (DTF, DTG).

Über das Team Wir sind fokussiert, lösungsorientiert und können auf die bevorstehenden Herausforderungen reagieren. Wir etablieren und verfolgen Prozesse, stehen aber auch kontinuierlich mit dem Status Quo und dem Industriestandard in Verbindung. Wir sind Ingenieure, die die Ideen von spitzensportbekleidungsdesign in die funktionale Realität lenken. Wir sind in der Lage, innovative Konzepte und Prototypen in marktfähige Produkte mit strengen Qualitäts- und Engineeringstandards umzuwandeln und sie in die Hände unserer anspruchsvollen, globalen Kundenbasis zu bringen.

Die Produktgestaltung ist eine Denkkraft und jedes Teammitglied ist befugt, Entscheidungen zu treffen, mit dem Verständnis, dass Scheitern Teil des Lern- und Wachstumsprozesses ist. Als integrierte Funktion in der Design- und Entwicklungsorganisation sind wir detailorientierte Problemlösungen; führen und realisieren Sie die technische Entwicklung der Bekleidung innerhalb knapper Zeit und der höchstmöglichen Produktqualität, sowohl im Regal als auch im Gebrauch.
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Description Nous recherchons un fabricant d'échantillons motivé et axé sur les détails, passionné de vêtements sportifs et prêts à porter. Dans ce rôle, vous serez responsable de la création de prototypes, de muscins et de maquettes de haute qualité en partenariat avec les ingénieurs de motifs, le développement de produits et les concepteurs pour donner vie aux concepts de produits. Le candidat idéal a une base solide dans la manipulation des tissus (à la fois la coupe et la couture), la construction de vêtements et les techniques de couture.

Il s'agit d'un contrat de 6 mois avec possibilité de permanent.

Responsabilités - Construisez des prototypes en fonction des spécifications techniques, des modèles et des méthodes de construction alternatives en collaboration avec des équipes interfonctionnelles. - Déterminez les tissus, les garnitures et les techniques de couture optimales pour les vêtements de haute performance. - Identifier et résoudre les défis de construction. - Soutenir les transitions prototype-production à un niveau de qualité supérieure. - Veiller à ce que les échantillons répondent aux normes de qualité strictes pour la couture, la durabilité et la finition. - Maintenir un espace de travail organisé et un workflow efficace.

- Restez à jour sur les tendances de l'industrie sportive et prêt à porter et les techniques de couture avancées, spécifiques à l'apparence et à la fonction.

Qualifications et compétences

Expérience - 8 ans et plus d'expérience en tant que fabricant d'échantillons, égout d'échantillons ou dans un rôle similaire dans la fabrication de vêtements, y compris l'expérience d'emploi dans une usine, salle d'échantillonnage ou atelier de couture. - Compétence technique démontrée dans la manipulation et la couture de fabrications complexes, couvrant à la fois les textiles extensibles et non extensibles. - Expérience avancée en couture d'athlétisme et prêt à porter des vêtements. - Compréhension de la construction de vêtements et de l'interprétation de motifs.

Compétences techniques - Compétences en matière d'utilisation de machines à coudre industrielles (simple besoin, verrouillage, covertitch, etc.). - Capacité de lire et de suivre des modèles, des fiches techniques et des croquis techniques. - Expérience de travail avec toutes les fabrications - Une grande attention aux détails et un engagement pour l'artisanat de qualité.

Qualifications privilégiées - Expérience des logiciels numériques de fabrication de motifs (p. ex. Gerber, Lectra) est un atout. - Connaissance de base des techniques de teinture, de lavage ou d'impression textile (DTF, DTG).

Nous sommes des ingénieurs qui orientent les idées de conception de vêtements de sport pinnacle en réalité fonctionnelle. Nous sommes en mesure de convertir des concepts et des prototypes innovants en produits commercialisés avec des normes de qualité et d'ingénierie rigoureuses, les mettant entre les mains de notre clientèle mondiale et exigeante.

La création de produits est un état d'esprit et chaque membre de l'équipe est habilité à prendre des décisions en sachant que l'échec fait partie du processus d'apprentissage et de croissance. En tant que fonction intégrée dans l'organisation de conception et de développement, nous sommes des résolveurs de problèmes aux prises avec des détails; guidant et exécutant le développement technique de vêtements dans des délais serrés et la plus haute qualité possible de produit, tant sur l'étagère que dans l'utilisation.

jobs.title: Lead - Tooling Engineer
jobs.description:
In short

As Footwear Tooling Engineer you will create groundbreaking concepts and products for high-performance athletes while advancing On’s sustainability goals. Working in a collaborative environment, you’ll shape the future direction of our pinnacle performance product and technologies through Innovation and Design.

You will act as the owner of the bottom unit development for our pinnacle performance product and technologies. You will work in close collaboration with designers and developers here at On Labs in Zurich and our Tooling team in Vietnam to create the highest quality products. From concept creation through prototyping, you will guide the team on bottom unit materials, geometries, and construction from a critical manufacturing, biomechanical performance, and durability viewpoint. You will also be a key player in identifying and creating process improvements for all bottom unit development across the company.

Your mission

- Lead the bottom unit development for On’s performance products

- Provide solutions to design and construction constraints by using your demonstrated knowledge of materials, mold construction and manufacturing

- Evaluate and improve product designs for manufacturability and durability by reviewing 2D/3D CADs, prototypes, and feedback from the testing teams

- Ensure alignment with product specifications and manufacturing capabilities

- Use your understanding of plastics injection molding to advise cost, design, and molding capabilities of injected components in the bottom unit

- Collaborate with our Asian counterparts and support mold shop teams on tooling revisions and manufacturing concerns

- Assist the development, product management, and design teams with any tooling related questions or issues

- Evaluate current workflows and create process improvements to maximize efficiencies and advance testing

Your story

- Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Industrial Design, or a related field

- Minimum of 5 years experience within a footwear engineering role working closely with development and production, ideally in a footwear tooling development

- Technical knowledge of various materials, mold construction, and manufacturing processes relevant to footwear; In-depth knowledge of plastics injection molding principles, including advising on cost, design, and molding capabilities of injected components

- Experience working with 2D and 3D CADs (Rhino a bonus); proficiency in reviewing and evaluating 2D/3D CADs for manufacturability, durability, and alignment with product specifications

- Experience in 3D modelling and rapid prototyping tools

- Demonstrated experience in project management, costing, and the ability to provide solutions within complex constraints

- Experience working with biomechanical performance principles as they relate to footwear bottom unit design

- Experience working cross-functionally across designers, developers, product management, and testing teams

- Experience collaborating with international manufacturing partners on tooling revisions and manufacturing concerns

- Strong communication skills to provide clear guidance and technical support to various stakeholders.

- Excellent time management skills and ability to work with multiple deadlines

- Available to travel to Asia at least 2 times a year

The team

Our mission is to define and create the future of sportswear bringing to life groundbreaking innovations. Acting at the forefront of material science, sport science and engineering we develop products that push the boundaries of performance and sustainability, blending in unique aesthetic appeal that embodies On’s design DNA.

descriptionByLocale.it:
In breve

Come Footwear Tooling Engineer creerete concetti e prodotti innovativi per atleti ad alte prestazioni mentre avanzano gli obiettivi di sostenibilità On.s. Lavorando in un ambiente collaborativo, si.ll plasma la direzione futura del nostro prodotto e delle tecnologie per prestazioni pinnacle attraverso Innovazione e Design.

Lavorerai in stretta collaborazione con designer e sviluppatori di On Labs a Zurigo e con il nostro team Tooling in Vietnam per creare prodotti di altissima qualità. Dalla creazione di concept fino alla prototipazione, guiderai il team su materiali di base, geometrie e costruzioni da un punto di vista critico della produzione, delle prestazioni biomeccaniche e della durata.

Sarete anche un giocatore chiave nell'identificazione e nella creazione di miglioramenti di processo per tutto lo sviluppo delle unità di fondo in tutta l'azienda.

La tua missione

- Guidare lo sviluppo dell'unità inferiore per i prodotti di performance On.s

- Fornire soluzioni per la progettazione e vincoli costruttivi utilizzando la vostra conoscenza dimostrata dei materiali, costruzione di stampi e produzione

- Evaluare e migliorare i progetti di prodotto per la capacità di resistenza e la durata, recensendo CAD 2D/3D, prototipi e feedback dai team di test

- Garantire l'allineamento con le specifiche del prodotto e le capacità di produzione

- Utilizzare la comprensione dello stampaggio ad iniezione in plastica per consigliare costi, progettazione e capacità di stampaggio dei componenti iniettati nell'unità inferiore

- Il 'Canada' con i nostri omologhi asiatici e supporta i team dei negozi di stampi sulle revisioni degli utensili e sulle preoccupazioni di fabbricazione

- Assistere lo sviluppo, la gestione dei prodotti e la progettazione team con qualsiasi domanda o problemi relativi strumento

- Evaluare i flussi di lavoro correnti e creare miglioramenti di processo per massimizzare l'efficienza e il test di avanzamento

La tua storia

- Laurea in Ingegneria Meccanica, Disegno Industriale o in un campo correlato

- Minimo 5 anni di esperienza in un ruolo di ingegneria calzaturiera lavorando a stretto contatto con lo sviluppo e la produzione, idealmente in uno sviluppo di attrezzi calzaturieri

- Conoscenza tecnica dei vari materiali, costruzione di stampi e processi di produzione relativi alle calzature; Conoscenza approfondita dei principi di stampaggio ad iniezione delle materie plastiche, compresa la consulenza sui costi, la progettazione e le capacità di stampaggio dei componenti iniettati

- Esperienza lavorando con CAD 2D e 3D (un bonus di Rhino); competenza nella revisione e valutazione dei CAD 2D/3D per la capacità di sfruttare, mantenere e allineare le specifiche del prodotto

- Esperienza in strumenti di modellazione 3D e prototipazione rapida

- Esperienza dimostrativa nella gestione dei progetti, costi e capacità di fornire soluzioni entro vincoli complessi

- Esperienza lavorando con i principi di performance biomeccanica in quanto si riferiscono alla progettazione di fondo calzatura

- Esperienza lavorando in modo cross-funzionale tra progettisti, sviluppatori, gestione dei prodotti e team di test

- Esperienza di collaborazione con partner industriali internazionali sulle revisioni degli utensili e sulle problematiche di fabbricazione

- Forte capacità comunicative per fornire orientamenti e supporto tecnico chiari ai vari soggetti interessati.

- Ottima capacità di gestione del tempo e capacità di lavorare con scadenze multiple

- Disponibile per viaggiare in Asia almeno 2 volte all'anno

La squadra

La nostra missione è definire e creare il futuro dello sportswear portando alla luce innovazioni innovative. Aggendo all'avanguardia nella scienza dei materiali, nello sport e nell'ingegneria sviluppiamo prodotti che spingono i confini delle prestazioni e della sostenibilità, mescolandosi in un unico appeal estetico che incarna il DNA di progettazione On.s.

descriptionByLocale.de:
Kurz gefasst

Als Footwear Tooling Engineer erstellen Sie bahnbrechende Konzepte und Produkte für Hochleistungssportler und fördern dabei On,s Nachhaltigkeitsziele. In einem kollaborativen Umfeld gestalten Sie die Zukunftsrichtung unseres Spitzenleistungsprodukts und unserer Technologien durch Innovation und Design.

Sie werden als Eigentümer der Entwicklung der unteren Einheit für unsere Spitzenleistung Produkt und Technologien. Sie werden in enger Zusammenarbeit mit Designern und Entwicklern hier bei On Labs in Zürich und unserem Tooling-Team in Vietnam, um die höchste Qualität Produkte zu schaffen. Von der Konzepterstellung bis zum Prototyping, Sie werden das Team auf unteren Einheiten Materialien, geiseln, und Konstruktion aus einer kritischen Herstellung, biomechanische Leistung und Haltbarkeitssicht führen.

Sie werden auch ein wichtiger Akteur bei der Identifizierung und Erstellung von Prozessverbesserungen für alle unteren Einheiten Entwicklung im Unternehmen.

Ihre Mission

- Führen Sie die untere Einheit Entwicklung für On,s Performance-Produkte

- Bereitstellung von Lösungen für Design- und Konstruktionsbeschränkungen mit Ihren bewährten Kenntnissen in Materialien, Formenbau und Herstellung

- Bewertung und Verbesserung der Produktdesigns für Manufacturability und Haltbarkeit durch Überprüfung von 2D/3D CADs, Prototypen und Feedback der Testteams

- Gewährleistung der Abstimmung mit Produktspezifikationen und Fertigungskapazitäten

- Nutzen Sie Ihr Verständnis von Kunststoffspritzguss, um Kosten, Design und Formfähigkeiten von eingespritzten Komponenten im unteren Bereich zu beraten

- Zusammenarbeit mit unseren asiatischen Kollegen und Unterstützung von Werkzeugbauteams bei Werkzeugrevisionen und Fertigungsbedenken

- Unterstützung der Entwicklungs-, Produktmanagement- und Designteams bei Fragen oder Problemen rund um das Werkzeug

- Bewertung der aktuellen Workflows und Prozessverbesserungen zur Maximierung der Effizienz und Vorprüfung

Ihre Geschichte

- Bachelor in Maschinenbau, Industriedesign oder einem verwandten Bereich

- Mindestens 5 Jahre Erfahrung in einer schuhverarbeitenden Funktion, die eng mit Entwicklung und Produktion zusammenarbeitet, idealerweise in einer schuhverarbeitenden Entwicklung

- Technische Kenntnisse der verschiedenen Materialien, Formenbau und Herstellungsverfahren, die für Schuhe relevant sind; Tiefe Kenntnisse der Kunststoffspritzguss-Grundsätze, einschließlich Beratung über Kosten, Design und Formungsfähigkeiten von eingespritzten Komponenten

- Erfahrung in der Arbeit mit 2D und 3D CADs (Rhino a bonus); Kenntnisse in der Überprüfung und Bewertung von 2D/3D CADs für die Herstellungsfähigkeit, Haltbarkeit und Ausrichtung mit Produktspezifikationen

- Erfahrung in 3D-Modellierung und Rapid Prototyping-Tools

- Vorgestellte Erfahrung in Projektmanagement, Kostenrechnung und die Fähigkeit, Lösungen innerhalb komplexer Zwänge anzubieten

- Erfahrung mit biomechanischen Leistungsprinzipien, da sie sich auf die Fußunterteil-Design beziehen

- Erleben Sie funktionsübergreifend in Designern, Entwicklern, Produktmanagement und Testteams arbeiten

- Erfahrung in der Zusammenarbeit mit internationalen Fertigungspartnern bei Werkzeugrevisionen und Fertigungsbelangen

- Starke Kommunikationsfähigkeiten, um verschiedene Akteure klar zu beraten und technisch zu unterstützen.

- Ausgezeichnete Zeitmanagement-Fähigkeiten und die Fähigkeit, mit mehreren Fristen zu arbeiten

- Verfügbar für Reisen nach Asien mindestens 2 mal im Jahr

Das Team

Unsere Mission ist es, die Zukunft der Sportbekleidung zu definieren und zu schaffen, die bahnbrechende Innovationen zum Leben erweckt. Mit der Arbeit an der Spitze der Materialwissenschaft, der Sportwissenschaft und der Technik entwickeln wir Produkte, die die Grenzen von Leistung und Nachhaltigkeit überschreiten und sich in einzigartiger ästhetischer Anziehungskraft vereinen, die On,s Design DNA verkörpert.
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Bref

En tant qu'ingénieur en outillage de chaussures, vous créerez des concepts et des produits révolutionnaires pour les athlètes de haut niveau tout en faisant progresser les objectifs de durabilité.

Vous serez le propriétaire du développement de l'unité de base pour nos produits et technologies de performance pinnacle. Vous travaillerez en étroite collaboration avec les concepteurs et développeurs ici à On Labs à Zurich et notre équipe d'outillage au Vietnam pour créer les produits de la plus haute qualité. De la création de concept jusqu'au prototypage, vous guiderez l'équipe sur les matériaux de base, les géométries et la construction du point de vue de la fabrication critique, des performances biomécaniques et de la durabilité.

Vous serez également un acteur clé dans l'identification et la création d'améliorations de processus pour tous les développements d'unités de base dans l'entreprise.

Votre mission

- Diriger le développement de l'unité inférieure pour On, produits de performance

- Fournir des solutions aux contraintes de conception et de construction en utilisant vos connaissances démontrées des matériaux, de la construction de moules et de la fabrication

- Évaluer et améliorer les conceptions de produits pour la fabrication et la durabilité en examinant les CAO 2D/3D, les prototypes et les commentaires des équipes d'essais

- Assurer l'alignement sur les spécifications du produit et les capacités de fabrication

- Utilisez votre compréhension du moulage par injection de plastique pour conseiller les coûts, la conception et les capacités de moulage des composants injectés dans l'unité inférieure

- Collaborer avec nos homologues asiatiques et soutenir les équipes de moulage sur les révisions d'outillage et les préoccupations de fabrication

- Aider les équipes de développement, de gestion des produits et de conception à répondre à toutes les questions ou questions liées à l'outillage

- Évaluer les flux de travail actuels et créer des améliorations de processus pour maximiser les gains d'efficacité et faire avancer les essais

Votre histoire

- Baccalauréat en génie mécanique, design industriel ou domaine connexe

- Au moins 5 ans d'expérience dans un rôle d'ingénierie de la chaussure en étroite collaboration avec le développement et la production, idéalement dans un développement d'outillage de chaussures

- Connaissances techniques de divers matériaux, construction de moules et procédés de fabrication pertinents pour la chaussure; Connaissance approfondie des principes de moulage par injection de plastiques, y compris des conseils sur le coût, la conception et les capacités de moulage des composants injectés

- Expérience de travail avec les CAO 2D et 3D (Rhino a bonus); compétence en révision et évaluation des CAO 2D/3D pour la fabrication, la durabilité et l'alignement avec les spécifications du produit

- Expérience de la modélisation 3D et des outils de prototypage rapide

- Expérience démontrée en gestion de projet, en établissement des coûts et en capacité de fournir des solutions dans des limites complexes

- Expérience de travail avec les principes de performance biomécaniques en ce qui concerne la conception de chaussures en bas

- Expérience de travail interfonctionnel entre concepteurs, développeurs, gestion de produits et équipes de test

- Expérience de collaboration avec des partenaires industriels internationaux sur les révisions des outils et les préoccupations de fabrication

- Des compétences en communication solides pour fournir des orientations claires et un soutien technique aux diverses parties prenantes.

- Excellente capacité de gestion du temps et de travailler avec de multiples échéances

- Disponible pour voyager en Asie au moins 2 fois par an

L'équipe

Notre mission est de définir et de créer l'avenir du sportwear apportant des innovations révolutionnaires. Agissant à l'avant-garde des sciences matérielles, des sciences du sport et de l'ingénierie, nous développons des produits qui repoussent les limites de la performance et de la durabilité, se mêlant à un attrait esthétique unique qui incarne l'ADN de conception On,s.

jobs.title: Lead - Spatial Designer, EMEA
jobs.description:
In Short:

At On, we’re redefining the boundaries of design and storytelling in sportswear. We are looking for a senior designer to lead on strategically planning and overseeing the delivery of immersive physical experiences in Europe, the Middle East and Africa (EMEA). These experiences will capture the essence of our brand - bringing our global campaigns to life in a wide range of retail environments across the region. Reporting to the Senior Creative Lead in our EMEA Creative Studio, you will help conceptualize, develop and deliver world-class spatial designs that express On’s identity through innovative use of form, material and narrative. Working with internal and external partners, you will translate On’s innovative spirit into memorable, locally relevant experiences for our fans across EMEA.

Your Mission:

• Adapt and localize global brand campaigns, tailoring their design and storytelling to create impactful, multi-door retail experiences across the region.

• Elevate the On retail environment by applying your expertise in 3D design, set design and scenography to translate concepts into locally relevant retail campaigns across all spatial touchpoints.

• Oversee the design of campaign activations for new store openings, pop-ups, and special events across our retail network.

• Drive the roadmap for the region, planning ahead and overseeing projects from strategic planning to creative execution.

• Work with external agencies, providing clear direction and managing feedback to ensure exceptional, scalable campaign executions.

• Collaborate with global and regional teams across Visual Experience, Retail, Marketing and Production to ensure a cohesive and impactful brand presence at every touchpoint.

• Champion creative problem-solving and challenge the status quo, using your design expertise to push boundaries and create dynamic, forward-thinking retail spaces.

Your Story:

• You’re likely to have 6+ years of experience in campaign or retail experience design for a premium, multi-door DTC brand.

• You have a portfolio that showcases your technical skills in 3D design, drawing and rendering - with a strong emphasis on retail environments and physical spaces, including windows, in-store spaces and pop-ups.

• Your expertise may span across 3D design, set design, spatial or scenographic design.

• You have experience with production drawings, material specification, and build processes.

• You’re an innovative and entrepreneurial thinker, consistently pushing creative boundaries and translating new ideas into tangible, executed designs that convey premium brand positioning.

• You’re an expert at managing multiple projects simultaneously, delivering high-quality work to tight deadlines without compromising on precision or excellence.

• You have a track record of successfully leading agencies or other partners to bring complex designs to life at scale through translating brand vision and design intent into actionable direction.

• You’re adept at navigating complex organizations, collaborating seamlessly across global and regional teams to achieve shared goals.

We’re more interested in the skills, mindset, and creative leadership you bring than in how many years you’ve spent in a specific role or industry. So if the above resonates with you, please feel empowered to apply.

Your Team:

This role can be based in either Zurich or London and you will sit at the intersection of several incredible teams packed with passionate people based primarily in those locations. The EMEA Brand Studio team tells compelling stories and brings experiences to life, all in pursuit of our mission to ignite the power of human spirit through movement. This work requires collaboration across the business. It is hybrid and flexible, 2-3 days per week in the office and some travel between Zurich, London, Paris, Berlin, Milan and other cities in the EMEA region. On is a Swiss company with a stunning local hub in Zurich and rapidly growing teams in London, Berlin and beyond.

What We Offer:

A fair and balanced internal recruiting process with an opportunity to learn about other teams, roles and challenges.

On is a place that is centered around growth and progress. We offer an environment designed to give people the tools to develop holistically – to stay active, to learn, explore and innovate. Our distinctive approach combines a supportive, team-oriented atmosphere, with access to personal self-care for both physical and mental well-being, so each person is led by purpose.

On is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to creating a work environment that is fair and inclusive, where all decisions related to recruitment, advancement, and retention are free of discrimination.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Designazione delle merci

In breve:

At On, stiamo ridefinendo i confini del design e della storytelling nello sportswear. Stiamo cercando un senior designer che conduca alla pianificazione strategica e alla supervisione della consegna di esperienze fisiche di tipo 126ve in Europa, Medio Oriente e Africa (EMEA). Queste esperienze cattureranno l'essenza del nostro marchio - portando le nostre campagne globali alla vita in un'ampia gamma di ambienti retail in tutta la regione.

Reporting to the Senior Creative Lead nel nostro EMEA Creative Studio, aiuterai a concettualizzare, sviluppare e fornire design spaziali di livello mondiale che esprimono l'identità On.s attraverso l'uso innovativo di forma, materiale e narrativa. Lavorando con partner interni ed esterni, tradurrai lo spirito innovativo On.s in esperienze memorabili e localmente rilevanti per i nostri fan in tutta l'EMEA.

La tua missione

- Adattare e localizzare campagne di brand globali, personalizzare il loro design e storyteling diding per creare esperienze retail multi-door impattanti in tutta la regione. - Aumentare l'ambiente On retail applicando la tua esperienza in 3D design, scenografia e design per tradurre i concetti in campagne retail locali rilevanti in tutti i touchpoint spaziali. - Sovravedere la progettazione di attivazioni di campagna per nuove aperture di negozi, pop-up, ed eventi speciali attraverso la nostra rete retail. - Guidare la roadmap per la regione, pianificare e supervisionare i progetti dalla pianificazione strategica all'esecuzione creativa.

- Collabora con agenzie esterne, fornendo una chiara direzione e gestione dei feedback per garantire esecuzioni di campagne eccezionali e scalabili. - Collabora con team globali e regionali attraverso Visual Experience, Retail, Marketing e Produzione per garantire una presenza coesa e impattante del marchio in ogni touchpoint. - Champion creation problem-solving e sfidare lo status quo, utilizzando la tua esperienza di design per spingere i confini e creare spazi retail dinamici e lungimiranti.

La tua storia

- È probabile che tu abbia 6+ anni di esperienza nella progettazione di campagne o di esperienze al dettaglio per un marchio DTC premium multi-porta. - Hai un portafoglio che mostra le tue competenze tecniche in progettazione 3D, disegno e rendering - con una forte enfasi sugli ambienti al dettaglio e spazi fisici, tra cui finestre, spazi in negozio e pop-up. - La tua esperienza può spaziare su progettazione 3D, scenografia, progettazione spaziale o scenografica. - Hai esperienza con disegni di produzione, specifiche dei materiali e processi di costruzione.

- Sei un pensatore innovativo e imprenditoriale, spingendo costantemente i confini creativi e traducendo nuove idee in progetti tangibili e eseguiti che trasmettono posizionamento di marchio premium. - Sei un esperto nella gestione di più progetti contemporaneamente, offrendo un lavoro di alta qualità a scadenze strette senza compromettere la precisione o l'eccellenza. - Hai un track record di agenzie leader di successo o altri partner per portare progetti complessi a vita in scala attraverso la traduzione di visione del marchio e design intenta in direzione attuabile.

- Sei abile a navigare in organizzazioni complesse, collaborando senza soluzione di continuità tra team globali e regionali per raggiungere obiettivi condivisi.

La tua squadra

Questo ruolo può essere basato a Zurigo o Londra e vi siederà all'incrocio di diversi team incredibili, ricchi di persone appassionate, che si trovano principalmente in quelle sedi. Il team EMEA Brand Studio racconta storie avvincenti e dà vita a esperienze, tutti in cerca della nostra missione di accendere il potere dello spirito umano attraverso il movimento. Questo lavoro richiede collaborazione in tutta l'attività. È ibrido e flessibile, 2-3 giorni a settimana in ufficio e alcuni viaggi tra Zurigo, Londra, Parigi, Berlino, Milano e altre città della regione EMEA.

È una società svizzera con un centro locale mozzafiato a Zurigo e team in rapida crescita a Londra, Berlino e oltre.

Cosa offriamo

- Un processo di reclutamento interno equo ed equilibrato con l'opportunità di conoscere altri team, ruoli e sfide. - On è un luogo che è centrata sulla crescita e il progresso. Offriamo un ambiente progettato per dare alle persone gli strumenti per sviluppare olisticamente. per rimanere attive, per imparare, esplorare e innovare. - Il nostro approccio distintivo combina un'atmosfera di supporto, orientata al team, con l'accesso alla cura personale di sé per il benessere fisico e mentale, così ogni persona è guidata da uno scopo. - On è un datore di lavoro pari opportunità.

Ci impegniamo a creare un ambiente di lavoro equo e inclusivo, dove tutte le decisioni relative al reclutamento, al progresso e al mantenimento sono esenti da discriminazioni.

descriptionByLocale.de:
Warenbezeichnung

Kurz gesagt:

Bei On definieren wir die Grenzen von Design und Storytelling in der Sportbekleidung. Wir suchen einen Senior Designer, der die strategische Planung und Überwachung der Bereitstellung von dauerhaften physischen Erfahrungen in Europa, dem Nahen Osten und Afrika (EMEA) übernimmt. Diese Erfahrungen werden das Wesen unserer Marke erfassen - unsere globalen Kampagnen in einer Vielzahl von Einzelhandelsumgebungen in der Region zum Leben erwecken.

Sie werden in unserem EMEA Creative Studio an den Senior Creative Lead berichten und helfen, weltklasse Raumentwürfe zu konzipieren, zu entwickeln und zu liefern, die On,s Identität durch innovative Nutzung von Form, Material und Erzählung zum Ausdruck bringen. In Zusammenarbeit mit internen und externen Partnern übersetzen Sie On,s Innovationsgeist in unvergessliche, lokal relevante Erfahrungen für unsere Fans in ganz EMEA.

Ihre Mission

- Anpassung und Lokalisierung globaler Markenkampagnen, Anpassung ihres Designs und Storytellings an die Schaffung von wirkungsreichen, multi-door-Handelserlebnissen in der Region. - Elevate the On Retail-Umgebung durch Anwendung Ihrer Expertise in 3D-Design, Set Design und Szenografie, um Konzepte in lokal relevante Retail-Kampagnen über alle räumlichen Touchpoints hinweg zu übersetzen. - Überwachen Sie die Gestaltung von Kampagnenaktivierungen für neue Store-Openings, Pop-ups und Sonderveranstaltungen in unserem Retail-Netzwerk. - Fahren Sie die Roadmap für die Region, planen Sie voraus und überwachen Sie Projekte von der strategischen Planung bis zur kreativen Umsetzung.

- Arbeiten Sie mit externen Agenturen zusammen, indem Sie klare Richtungs- und Feedback-Referenzen bereitstellen, um außergewöhnliche, skalierbare Kampagnenausführungen zu gewährleisten. - Arbeiten Sie mit globalen und regionalen Teams in den Bereichen Visual Experience, Retail, Marketing und Produktion zusammen, um eine kohärente und wirkungsvolle Markenpräsenz an jedem Berührungspunkt zu gewährleisten. - Championieren Sie kreative Problemlösungen und fordern Sie den Status Quo heraus, indem Sie Ihre Designkompetenz nutzen, um Grenzen zu überschreiten und dynamische, zukunftsweisende Einzelhandelsflächen zu schaffen.

Ihre Geschichte

- Sie haben wahrscheinlich mehr als 6 Jahre Erfahrung in der Kampagnen- oder Einzelhandelserfahrungsgestaltung für eine Premium-DTC-Marke mit mehreren Türen. - Sie haben ein Portfolio, das Ihre technischen Fähigkeiten in 3D-Design, Zeichnung und Rendering zeigt - mit einem starken Schwerpunkt auf Einzelhandelsumgebungen und physischen Räumen, einschließlich Fenstern, Ladenräumen und Pop-ups. - Ihre Expertise kann sich über 3D-Design, Set-Design, räumliche oder szenografische Design. - Sie haben Erfahrung mit Produktionszeichnungen, Materialspezifikation und Bauprozesse.

- Sie sind ein innovativer und unternehmerischer Denker, der kreative Grenzen konsequent sprengt und neue Ideen in greifbare, ausgeführte Designs übersetzt, die Premium-Markenpositionierung vermitteln. - Sie sind ein Experte bei der Verwaltung mehrerer Projekte gleichzeitig, liefert hochwertige Arbeit zu engen Fristen, ohne Kompromisse bei Präzision oder Exzellenz. - Sie haben eine Erfolgsbilanz von erfolgreichen führenden Agenturen oder anderen Partnern, um komplexe Designs auf dem Niveau zu bringen, indem Sie Markenvision und Design-Intent in eine handlungsfähige Richtung übersetzen.

- Sie sind sehr geschickt darin, komplexe Organisationen zu navigieren, und arbeiten nahtlos in globalen und regionalen Teams zusammen, um gemeinsame Ziele zu erreichen.

Ihr Team

Diese Rolle kann in Zürich oder London angesiedelt sein und Sie sitzen an der Kreuzung mehrerer unglaublicher Teams mit leidenschaftlichen Menschen, die vor allem an diesen Standorten angesiedelt sind. Das EMEA Brand Studio Team erzählt überzeugende Geschichten und bringt Erfahrungen zum Leben, die alle in der Verfolgung unserer Mission, die Kraft des menschlichen Geistes durch Bewegung zu entfachen, zum Leben erweckt werden. Diese Arbeit erfordert eine Zusammenarbeit im gesamten Unternehmen. Es ist hybrid und flexibel, 2-3 Tage pro Woche im Büro und einige Reisen zwischen Zürich, London, Paris, Berlin, Mailand und anderen Städten in der EMEA-Region.

On ist ein Schweizer Unternehmen mit einem atemberaubenden lokalen Hub in Zürich und schnell wachsenden Teams in London, Berlin und darüber hinaus.

Was wir anbieten

- Ein fairer und ausgewogener interner Recruiting-Prozess mit der Möglichkeit, über andere Teams, Rollen und Herausforderungen zu lernen. - On ist ein Ort, der sich um Wachstum und Fortschritt dreht. Wir bieten ein Umfeld, das den Menschen die Werkzeuge gibt, sich ganzheitlich zu entwickeln – aktiv zu bleiben, zu lernen, zu erforschen und zu innovativ zu sein. - Unser unverwechselbarer Ansatz kombiniert eine unterstützende, teamorientierte Atmosphäre mit Zugang zur persönlichen Selbstversorgung für körperliches und geistiges Wohlbefinden, so dass jeder Mensch durch den Zweck geführt wird. - On ist ein Arbeitgeber der Chancengleichheit.

Wir verpflichten uns, ein faires und integratives Arbeitsumfeld zu schaffen, in dem alle Entscheidungen im Zusammenhang mit der Einstellung, dem Fortschritt und der Beibehaltung frei von Diskriminierung sind.
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Désignation des marchandises

En bref :

Nous sommes à la recherche d'un designer senior qui sera chargé de planifier et de superviser stratégiquement la livraison d'expériences physiques immersive en Europe, au Moyen-Orient et en Afrique (EMEA). Ces expériences vont capter l'essence de notre marque - mettant en scène nos campagnes mondiales dans un large éventail d'environnements de vente au détail dans toute la région.

En vous adressant au Senior Creative Lead de notre studio créatif EMEA, vous aiderez à conceptualiser, développer et livrer des designs spatiaux de classe mondiale qui expriment l'identité par l'utilisation novatrice de la forme, du matériel et du narratif. En travaillant avec des partenaires internes et externes, vous traduirez l'esprit innovant en expériences mémorables et pertinentes localement pour nos fans dans l'ensemble de l'EMEA.

Votre mission

- Adapter et localiser les campagnes de marque mondiales, adapter leur conception et leur narration pour créer des expériences de vente au détail multiportes et impactées dans toute la région. - Élever l'environnement de vente au détail en appliquant votre expertise en conception 3D, conception de set et scénographie pour traduire des concepts en campagnes de vente au détail locales dans tous les points de contact spatiaux. - Superviser la conception des activations de campagne pour les nouvelles ouvertures de magasins, pop-ups et événements spéciaux sur notre réseau de vente au détail.

- Collaborer avec des équipes mondiales et régionales dans le cadre de l'expérience visuelle, du commerce de détail, du marketing et de la production afin d'assurer une présence de marque cohérente et pertinente à chaque point de contact. - Champion créatif résolution de problèmes et défier le statu quo, en utilisant votre expertise de conception pour repousser les frontières et créer des espaces de vente dynamiques et prospectifs.

Votre histoire

- Vous avez probablement 6 ans d'expérience dans la conception d'expérience de campagne ou de vente au détail pour une marque DTC multiportes premium. - Vous avez un portefeuille qui met en valeur vos compétences techniques en conception, dessin et rendu 3D - avec un accent particulier sur les environnements de vente au détail et les espaces physiques, y compris les fenêtres, les espaces en magasin et les pop-ups. - Votre expertise peut couvrir la conception 3D, la conception de décors, la conception spatiale ou scénographique. - Vous avez de l'expérience avec les dessins de production, la spécification des matériaux et les processus de construction.

- Vous êtes un penseur innovant et entrepreneurial, repoussant constamment les frontières créatives et traduisant de nouvelles idées en des designs tangibles et exécutés qui transmettent un positionnement de marque premium. - Vous êtes un expert dans la gestion simultanée de plusieurs projets, fournissant un travail de haute qualité à des délais serrés sans compromettre la précision ou l'excellence. - Vous avez une expérience de la réussite des agences leaders ou d'autres partenaires pour mettre en œuvre des designs complexes à l'échelle en traduisant la vision de marque et l'intention de conception en direction actionnable.

- Vous êtes adepte de la navigation des organisations complexes, collaborant de façon transparente entre les équipes mondiales et régionales pour atteindre des objectifs communs.

Votre équipe

Ce rôle peut être basé à Zurich ou à Londres et vous vous retrouverez à l'intersection de plusieurs équipes incroyables, remplies de passionnés, principalement dans ces lieux. L'équipe de Brand Studio d'EMEA raconte des histoires fascinantes et met en valeur nos expériences, tout en poursuivant notre mission de mettre en valeur la puissance de l'esprit humain par le mouvement. Ce travail exige une collaboration dans l'ensemble de l'entreprise.

On est une entreprise suisse avec un superbe hub local à Zurich et des équipes en croissance rapide à Londres, Berlin et au-delà.

Ce que nous offrons

- Un processus de recrutement interne équitable et équilibré qui permet de découvrir d'autres équipes, rôles et défis. - Nous offrons un environnement qui permet de développer les outils de manière holistique – rester actif, apprendre, explorer et innover. - Notre approche distinctive combine une atmosphère de soutien et de travail en équipe, avec l'accès à des soins personnels pour le bien-être physique et mental, de sorte que chaque personne est dirigée par un but. - Nous sommes un employeur à égalité de chances.

Nous sommes déterminés à créer un milieu de travail équitable et inclusif, où toutes les décisions liées au recrutement, à l'avancement et au maintien en poste sont exemptes de discrimination.

jobs.description:
Generative Intelligence and Search Ecosystem Analyst

In Short

The way the world discovers information is undergoing a fundamental shift. Consumers are moving away from traditional search engines toward a fragmented ecosystem of AI assistants, agentic models, and decentralized social channels. At On, we address this transformation through our "Search Everywhere" initiative.

As the Lead - Generative Intelligence and Search Ecosystem Analyst , you will be the primary intelligence architect of On’s visibility in this fragmented "Search Everywhere" reality, moving beyond the legacy metrics of keyword rankings and organic traffic to a more holistic understanding of brand authority, entity recall, and AI-driven recommendations. You will lead the insights generation and data-driven recommendations to help ensure On remains the "cited answer" in a world dominated by AI-driven recommendations, generative engines, and decentralized social ecosystems. You will tackle complex, ambiguous challenges by treating Large Language Models (LLMs) as the new search index, ensuring our technical innovations (from CloudTec™ to LightSpray™), product attributes and brand stories are accurately represented and recommended to consumers globally.

Your Mission

• Strategic Vision for Discovery: Own the long-term roadmap for On’s visibility across the "Search Everywhere" landscape, moving the organization from tracking rankings to mastering "entity authority" and AI recall.

• Ecosystem Intelligence: Lead the analysis of the non-linear customer journey, using advanced clickstream and behavioral data to identify exactly where and how consumers are shifting their trust from traditional search engines to generative AI and social platforms.

• Technical Authority on Retrieval: Serve as the internal expert on Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG). You will define the technical standards for how our product data should be structured to be "machine-readable" and "summarization-ready," minimizing AI hallucinations about our technology.

• Global Market Orchestration: Navigate the nuances of international search ecosystems (including Google, Baidu, Naver, and Yandex), ensuring On’s technological narrative is consistent and authoritative across different linguistic and algorithmic environments.

• Cross-Functional Influence: Partner with Paid and Organic Search, Content, Marketing, and Product teams to optimize budget allocation and content pipelines, acting as a trusted thought partner to bridge the gap between technical data engineering and brand storytelling.

• Operational Excellence: Partner with Data and Tech teams to guide the construction of scalable ETL pipelines for log file analysis, monitoring AI bot behavior (like GPTBot) at the server level to ensure high-value content is indexed and retrieved efficiently.

Your Story

• Proven Domain Expert: You have extensive experience (8+ years) in technical SEO and search analytics. You don’t just use tools; you have a track record of solving complex visibility problems and understand the underlying mechanics of how information is vectorized, retrieved, and presented.

• Future-proof mindset: You haven’t just watched the search landscape change; you have looked into how to adapt your toolkit. You have a working knowledge of emerging evaluation frameworks (such as NDCG or RAGAS) and are familiar with the specialized toolkits used to audit LLM responses and brand clarity. You stay ahead of the curve in emerging trends, such as visual search (Google Lens), agentic e-commerce, and the nuances of zero-party data.

• Technical Fluency: You are proficient in Python and SQL. You are comfortable working with large-scale datasets, server logs, and building the logic for automated intelligence dashboards.

• Collaborative Influencer: You are a strong communicator who can translate complex linguistic analytics into actionable business terms for senior stakeholders across regions and functions.

Meet the Team

You will join the Digital Customer Analytics team, a high performing team dedicated to the end-to-end customer journey, from optimizing performance marketing and site experimentation to analyzing purchasing behavior and long-term loyalty. We transform complex digital signals into actionable insights that fuel growth, retention, and a seamless shopping experience.

What We Offer

On is a place that is centered around growth and progress. We offer an environment designed to give people the tools to develop holistically – to stay active, to learn, explore and innovate. Our distinctive approach combines a supportive, team-oriented atmosphere, with access to personal self-care for both physical and mental well-being, so each person is led by purpose.

The way the world discovers information is undergoing a fundamental shift. Consumers are moving away from traditional search engines toward a fragmented ecosystem of AI assistants, agentic models, and decentralized social channels. At On, we address this transformation through our "Search Everywhere" initiative.

As the Lead - Generative Intelligence and Search Ecosystem Analyst , you will be the primary intelligence architect of On’s visibility in this fragmented "Search Everywhere" reality, moving beyond the legacy metrics of keyword rankings and organic traffic to a more holistic understanding of brand authority, entity recall, and AI-driven recommendations. You will lead the insights generation and data-driven recommendations to help ensure On remains the "cited answer" in a world dominated by AI-driven recommendations, generative engines, and decentralized social ecosystems. You will tackle complex, ambiguous challenges by treating Large Language Models (LLMs) as the new search index, ensuring our technical innovations (from CloudTec™ to LightSpray™), product attributes and brand stories are accurately represented and recommended to consumers globally.

Your Mission

• Strategic Vision for Discovery: Own the long-term roadmap for On’s visibility across the "Search Everywhere" landscape, moving the organization from tracking rankings to mastering "entity authority" and AI recall.

• Ecosystem Intelligence: Lead the analysis of the non-linear customer journey, using advanced clickstream and behavioral data to identify exactly where and how consumers are shifting their trust from traditional search engines to generative AI and social platforms.

• Technical Authority on Retrieval: Serve as the internal expert on Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG). You will define the technical standards for how our product data should be structured to be "machine-readable" and "summarization-ready," minimizing AI hallucinations about our technology.

• Global Market Orchestration: Navigate the nuances of international search ecosystems (including Google, Baidu, Naver, and Yandex), ensuring On’s technological narrative is consistent and authoritative across different linguistic and algorithmic environments.

• Cross-Functional Influence: Partner with Paid and Organic Search, Content, Marketing, and Product teams to optimize budget allocation and content pipelines, acting as a trusted thought partner to bridge the gap between technical data engineering and brand storytelling.

• Operational Excellence: Partner with Data and Tech teams to guide the construction of scalable ETL pipelines for log file analysis, monitoring AI bot behavior (like GPTBot) at the server level to ensure high-value content is indexed and retrieved efficiently.

Your Story

• Proven Domain Expert: You have extensive experience (8+ years) in technical SEO and search analytics. You don’t just use tools; you have a track record of solving complex visibility problems and understand the underlying mechanics of how information is vectorized, retrieved, and presented.

• Future-proof mindset: You haven’t just watched the search landscape change; you have looked into how to adapt your toolkit. You have a working knowledge of emerging evaluation frameworks (such as NDCG or RAGAS) and are familiar with the specialized toolkits used to audit LLM responses and brand clarity. You stay ahead of the curve in emerging trends, such as visual search (Google Lens), agentic e-commerce, and the nuances of zero-party data.

• Collaborative Influencer: You are a strong communicator who can translate complex linguistic analytics into actionable business terms for senior stakeholders across regions and functions.

Meet the Team

You will join the Digital Customer Analytics team, a high performing team dedicated to the end-to-end customer journey, from optimizing performance marketing and site experimentation to analyzing purchasing behavior and long-term loyalty. jobs.description:
In Short…

As the Lead Developer for PAD (Lifestyle) + Young Movers (Kids), you will be responsible for inline Lifestyle products in our fastest-growing, largest product vertical, alongside specialized development engineered specifically for the young movers in our community.

Honing craft takes time. It requires patience, resilience, and a dedication to the complex integration of footwear construction and systems. In this role, you are an individual contributor operating at the intersection of high-performance design for all-day wear and disciplined Swiss Engineering.

Your Mission…

• Commit to the Craft: You will lead the technical development for new silhouettes across both Adult and Kids categories, ensuring that every product meets strict engineering standards for performance, aesthetic, and fit.

• Master Complex Integration: You will serve as the primary technical partner to Design, converting creative dreams into commercial reality without compromising on function.

• Bridge the Generations: You will translate adult performance concepts into kid-specific footwear, understanding the unique biomechanical and durability needs of younger, developing feet.

Your Day-to-Day…

• Execute the Technical Lifecycle: Manage the end-to-end development process from initial 2D/3D design concepts through tech-packing, prototyping, and final production-ready samples.

• Drive Material & Tooling Innovation: Partner with material sourcing and tooling teams to test, validate, and implement new compounds, textiles, and manufacturing methods.

• Lead Fit & Wear Testing: Oversee rigorous fit and wear testing protocols for both adults and kids, analyzing feedback to iterate and optimize comfort, support, and durability.

• Collaborate Cross-Functionally: Act as the central technical hub between Design, Product Management, Sourcing, and Tier 1 factory partners to ensure timelines and margin targets are met.

• Optimize for Scale: Ensure blueprints and construction methods are optimized for mass production while maintaining the pristine aesthetic integrity of the brand.

Your Story…

• The Technical Authority: You bring 7+ years of footwear development experience , with a proven track record of launching highly complex, performance-driven lifestyle or athletic products. Experience in kids' footwear development is a massive plus.

• Resilient Individual Contributor: You have the patience and persistence to navigate the long development road. You take full accountability for the technical lifecycle and thrive when managing independent projects.

• A Problem Solver by Nature: Ingenuity is at your core. You think differently, challenge the status quo, and find elegance in solving the most difficult construction puzzles while maintaining superior performance.

• Global Collaborator: You have extensive experience working directly with overseas commercialization centers and factories, understanding how to communicate technical nuances across cultures.

Your Keys to Success…

• Thrive in Ambiguity: You don't wait for a perfect roadmap. In a fast-scaling environment, parameters change quickly; you view shifting priorities as an opportunity to innovate rather than a roadblock.

• Biased for Action (With Guardrails): You possess a strong sense of urgency. You know when to move fast and trust your gut, and when to pause to ensure Swiss-engineered quality isn't compromised.

• The "No Job Too Small" Mindset: Despite your seniority as a Lead, you are a hands-on builder. You are just as excited to brainstorm high-level platform concepts with Design as you are to roll up your sleeves and fix a tech-pack error.

• Comfortable with Constructive Friction: Innovation doesn’t happen in a vacuum. You welcome diverse perspectives, lean into healthy debate with Design and Product management, and use pushback to sharpen the final product.

• Continuous Learner: The footwear landscape—especially in sustainable materials and circularity—is evolving daily. You are naturally curious, constantly scouting new methods, and eager to apply fresh learnings to the PAD and Kids lines.
