• Contributor individuale resiliente: hai la pazienza e la persistenza di navigare lungo la strada di sviluppo. Prendere piena responsabilità per il ciclo di vita tecnico e prosperare quando si gestisce progetti indipendenti.

• Un Problem Solver della Natura: L'ingegno è al vostro centro. Pensi in modo diverso, sfida lo status quo, e trovare l'eleganza nel risolvere i puzzle di costruzione più difficili, mantenendo prestazioni superiori.

• Global Collaboratore: Hai una vasta esperienza di lavoro direttamente con centri di commercializzazione all'estero e fabbriche, comprendendo come comunicare sfumature tecniche in tutte le culture.

Le tue chiavi di successo...

• Thrive in Ambiguity: Non aspettate una roadmap perfetta. In un ambiente in rapida crescita, i parametri cambiano rapidamente; si osservano le priorità di spostamento come un'opportunità per innovare piuttosto che un blocco stradale.

• Biased for Action (Con Guardrails): Hai un forte senso di urgenza. Sai quando muoversi velocemente e fidarti del tuo istinto, e quando fermarti per garantire che la qualità ingegnerizzata svizzera non sia compromessa.

• The "No Job Too Small" Mindset: Nonostante la tua anzianità come Piombo, sei un costruttore di mani. Sei altrettanto entusiasta di brainstorming concetti di piattaforma di alto livello con Design come si sta per roll up le maniche e risolvere un errore tech-pack.

• Confortevole con la frizione costruttiva: l’innovazione non avviene in un vuoto. Si accolgono diverse prospettive, si appoggiano al dibattito sano con Design e Product Management, e utilizzare pushback per affinare il prodotto finale.

• Continuous Learner: Il paesaggio calzaturiero, soprattutto in materiali e circolarità sostenibili, si sta evolvendo ogni giorno. Siete naturalmente curiosi, costantemente esplorando nuovi metodi, e desiderosi di applicare nuove apprensioni alle linee PAD e Kids.
descriptionByLocale.en:
In Short…

As the Lead Developer for PAD (Lifestyle) + Young Movers (Kids), you will be responsible for inline Lifestyle products in our fastest-growing, largest product vertical, alongside specialized development engineered specifically for the young movers in our community.

Honing craft takes time. It requires patience, resilience, and a dedication to the complex integration of footwear construction and systems. In this role, you are an individual contributor operating at the intersection of high-performance design for all-day wear and disciplined Swiss Engineering.

Your Mission…

• Commit to the Craft: You will lead the technical development for new silhouettes across both Adult and Kids categories, ensuring that every product meets strict engineering standards for performance, aesthetic, and fit.

• Master Complex Integration: You will serve as the primary technical partner to Design, converting creative dreams into commercial reality without compromising on function.

• Bridge the Generations: You will translate adult performance concepts into kid-specific footwear, understanding the unique biomechanical and durability needs of younger, developing feet.

Your Day-to-Day…

• Execute the Technical Lifecycle: Manage the end-to-end development process from initial 2D/3D design concepts through tech-packing, prototyping, and final production-ready samples.

• Drive Material & Tooling Innovation: Partner with material sourcing and tooling teams to test, validate, and implement new compounds, textiles, and manufacturing methods.

• Lead Fit & Wear Testing: Oversee rigorous fit and wear testing protocols for both adults and kids, analyzing feedback to iterate and optimize comfort, support, and durability.

• Collaborate Cross-Functionally: Act as the central technical hub between Design, Product Management, Sourcing, and Tier 1 factory partners to ensure timelines and margin targets are met.

• Optimize for Scale: Ensure blueprints and construction methods are optimized for mass production while maintaining the pristine aesthetic integrity of the brand.

Your Story…

• The Technical Authority: You bring 7+ years of footwear development experience , with a proven track record of launching highly complex, performance-driven lifestyle or athletic products. Experience in kids' footwear development is a massive plus.

• Resilient Individual Contributor: You have the patience and persistence to navigate the long development road. You take full accountability for the technical lifecycle and thrive when managing independent projects.

• A Problem Solver by Nature: Ingenuity is at your core. You think differently, challenge the status quo, and find elegance in solving the most difficult construction puzzles while maintaining superior performance.

• Global Collaborator: You have extensive experience working directly with overseas commercialization centers and factories, understanding how to communicate technical nuances across cultures.

Your Keys to Success…

• Thrive in Ambiguity: You don't wait for a perfect roadmap. In a fast-scaling environment, parameters change quickly; you view shifting priorities as an opportunity to innovate rather than a roadblock.

• Biased for Action (With Guardrails): You possess a strong sense of urgency. You know when to move fast and trust your gut, and when to pause to ensure Swiss-engineered quality isn't compromised.

• The "No Job Too Small" Mindset: Despite your seniority as a Lead, you are a hands-on builder. You are just as excited to brainstorm high-level platform concepts with Design as you are to roll up your sleeves and fix a tech-pack error.

• Comfortable with Constructive Friction: Innovation doesn’t happen in a vacuum. You welcome diverse perspectives, lean into healthy debate with Design and Product management, and use pushback to sharpen the final product.

• Continuous Learner: The footwear landscape—especially in sustainable materials and circularity—is evolving daily. You are naturally curious, constantly scouting new methods, and eager to apply fresh learnings to the PAD and Kids lines.
descriptionByLocale.de:
Kurz gesagt...

Als Lead Developer für PAD (Lifestyle) + Young Movers (Kids) sind Sie für Inline-Lifestyle-Produkte in unserer am schnellsten wachsenden, größten Produktvertikale verantwortlich, neben einer spezialisierten Entwicklung, die speziell für die jungen Mover in unserer Community entwickelt wurde.

Hon-Craft braucht Zeit. Es erfordert Geduld, Widerstandsfähigkeit und ein Engagement für die komplexe Integration von Schuhkonstruktion und -systemen. In dieser Funktion sind Sie ein individueller Mitwirkender, der an der Schnittstelle von Hochleistungsdesign für Ganztagsbekleidung und diszipliniertem Swiss Engineering arbeitet.

Deine Mission...

• Engagieren Sie sich für das Handwerk: Sie werden die technische Entwicklung für neue Silhouetten in den Kategorien Erwachsene und Kinder leiten und sicherstellen, dass jedes Produkt strenge technische Standards für Leistung, Ästhetik und Passform erfüllt.

• Master Complex Integration: Sie werden als primärer technischer Partner für Design dienen und kreative Träume in kommerzielle Realität verwandeln, ohne Kompromisse bei der Funktion einzugehen.

• Brücke der Generationen: Sie werden erwachsene Leistungskonzepte in kinderspezifische Schuhe übersetzen und die einzigartigen biomechanischen und Haltbarkeitsbedürfnisse jüngerer, sich entwickelnder Füße verstehen.

Dein Tag-zu-Tag...

• Führen Sie den technischen Lebenszyklus aus: Verwalten Sie den End-to-End-Entwicklungsprozess von anfänglichen 2D/3D-Designkonzepten durch Tech-Packing, Prototyping und endgültige produktionsfähige Muster.

• Drive Material & Tooling Innovation: Partner mit Materialbeschaffungs- und Werkzeugteams, um neue Verbindungen, Textilien und Herstellungsmethoden zu testen, zu validieren und zu implementieren.

• Lead Fit & Wear Testing: Überwachen Sie strenge Pass- und Verschleißtestprotokolle für Erwachsene und Kinder und analysieren Sie Feedback, um Komfort, Unterstützung und Langlebigkeit zu iterieren und zu optimieren.

• Funktionell zusammenarbeiten: Handeln Sie als zentraler technischer Knotenpunkt zwischen Design, Produktmanagement, Beschaffung und Tier-1-Fabrikpartnern, um sicherzustellen, dass Zeitpläne und Margenziele erreicht werden.

• Optimieren Sie für den Maßstab: Stellen Sie sicher, dass Blaupausen und Konstruktionsmethoden für die Massenproduktion optimiert sind, während die ursprüngliche ästhetische Integrität der Marke erhalten bleibt.

Deine Geschichte...

• Die Technische Behörde: Sie bringen mehr als 7 Jahre Erfahrung in der Schuhentwicklung mit, mit einer nachgewiesenen Erfolgsbilanz bei der Einführung hochkomplexer, leistungsorientierter Lifestyle- oder Sportprodukte. Erfahrung in der Entwicklung von Kinderschuhen ist ein großes Plus.

• Resilienter Individual Contributor: Sie haben die Geduld und Ausdauer, um den langen Entwicklungsweg zu gehen. Sie übernehmen die volle Verantwortung für den technischen Lebenszyklus und gedeihen bei der Verwaltung unabhängiger Projekte.

• Ein Problemlöser von Natur aus: Einfallsreichtum ist in Ihrem Kern. Sie denken anders, fordern den Status quo heraus und finden Eleganz bei der Lösung der schwierigsten Konstruktionsrätsel, während Sie eine überlegene Leistung beibehalten.

• Global Collaborator: Sie haben umfangreiche Erfahrung in der direkten Zusammenarbeit mit ausländischen Vermarktungszentren und Fabriken und verstehen, wie Sie technische Nuancen über Kulturen hinweg kommunizieren können.

Ihre Schlüssel zum Erfolg...

• Gedeihen Sie in Mehrdeutigkeit: Sie warten nicht auf eine perfekte Roadmap. In einer schnell skalierenden Umgebung ändern sich die Parameter schnell; Sie betrachten wechselnde Prioritäten als Chance zur Innovation und nicht als Hindernis.

• Voreingenommen für Action (mit Guardrails): Sie besitzen ein starkes Gefühl der Dringlichkeit. Sie wissen, wann Sie sich schnell bewegen und Ihrem Bauch vertrauen müssen und wann Sie pausieren müssen, um sicherzustellen, dass die Qualität von Swiss Engineering nicht beeinträchtigt wird.

• Das "No Job Too Small" Mindset: Trotz Ihrer Seniorität als Lead sind Sie ein praktischer Builder. Sie sind genauso aufgeregt, High-Level-Plattformkonzepte mit Design zu brainstormen, wie Sie Ihre Ärmel hochkrempeln und einen Tech-Pack-Fehler beheben.

• Komfortabel mit konstruktiver Reibung: Innovation passiert nicht in einem Vakuum. Sie begrüßen vielfältige Perspektiven, lehnen sich in eine gesunde Debatte mit Design und Produktmanagement ein und verwenden Pushback, um das Endprodukt zu schärfen.

• Continuous Learner: Die Schuhlandschaft - insbesondere in nachhaltigen Materialien und Zirkularität - entwickelt sich täglich weiter. Sie sind natürlich neugierig, suchen ständig nach neuen Methoden und sind bestrebt, neue Erkenntnisse auf die PAD- und Kids-Linien anzuwenden.
descriptionByLocale.fr:
En bref...

En tant que développeur principal pour PAD (Lifestyle) + Young Movers (Kids), vous serez responsable des produits inline Lifestyle dans notre plus grand produit vertical en croissance rapide, ainsi que du développement spécialisé spécialement conçu pour les jeunes déménageurs dans notre communauté.

Le honning prend du temps. Elle exige patience, résilience et dévouement à l'intégration complexe de la construction et des systèmes de chaussures. Dans ce rôle, vous êtes un contributeur individuel opérant à l'intersection de la conception haute performance pour l'usure toute la journée et Swiss Engineering disciplinée.

Votre mission...

• Commit to the Craft: Vous dirigerez le développement technique de nouvelles silhouettes dans les catégories adulte et enfant, en veillant à ce que chaque produit respecte des normes d'ingénierie strictes pour la performance, l'esthétique et l'ajustement.

• Master Integration Complex: Vous serez le principal partenaire technique du Design, transformant les rêves créatifs en réalité commerciale sans compromettre la fonction.

• Relier les générations : Vous allez traduire des concepts de performance pour adultes en chaussures spécifiques aux enfants, en comprenant les besoins uniques en matière de biomécanique et de durabilité des pieds en développement.

Ton quotidien...

• Exécutez le cycle de vie technique : Gérez le processus de développement de bout en bout à partir des concepts de conception 2D/3D initiaux par l'emballage technique, le prototypage et les échantillons finals prêts à la production.

• Conduire le matériel et l'outillage Innovation: Partenaire avec des équipes d'approvisionnement et d'outillage pour tester, valider et mettre en œuvre de nouveaux composés, textiles et méthodes de fabrication.

• Tests de l'ajustement et de l'usure du plomb : Surveillez les protocoles rigoureux de test de l'ajustement et de l'usure pour les adultes et les enfants, en analysant la rétroaction pour itérer et optimiser le confort, le soutien et la durabilité.

• Collaborer avec les partenaires de l'usine de niveau 1 pour s'assurer que les délais et les marges cibles sont atteints.

• Optimiser pour l'échelle: Assurez-vous que les plans et les méthodes de construction sont optimisés pour la production de masse tout en maintenant l'intégrité esthétique de la marque.

Votre histoire...

• The Technical Authority: Vous apportez 7+ années d'expérience de développement de chaussures, avec une expérience éprouvée de lancement de produits de style de vie ou d'athlétisme hautement complexes et axés sur la performance. L'expérience dans le développement de chaussures pour enfants est un plus massif.

• Contributeur individuel résilient : Vous avez la patience et la persévérance de naviguer sur la longue route de développement. Vous assumez l'entière responsabilité du cycle de vie technique et vous prospèrez dans la gestion de projets indépendants.

• Un problème résolu par la nature : l'ingéniosité est à votre cœur. Vous pensez différemment, défiez le statu quo, et trouvez l'élégance dans la résolution des puzzles de construction les plus difficiles tout en maintenant des performances supérieures.

• Global Collaborator: Vous avez une vaste expérience de travail directement avec les centres et les usines de commercialisation à l'étranger, comprenant comment communiquer des nuances techniques à travers les cultures.

Vos clés pour réussir...

• Thrive in Ambiguity: Vous n'attendez pas une feuille de route parfaite. Dans un environnement à l'échelle rapide, les paramètres changent rapidement; vous considérez l'évolution des priorités comme une occasion d'innover plutôt qu'un obstacle.

• Faux pour agir (avec garde-corps) : Vous avez un fort sentiment d'urgence. Vous savez quand se déplacer rapidement et faire confiance à votre instinct, et quand faire une pause pour s'assurer que la qualité suisse ne soit pas compromise.

• L'esprit "Pas de travail trop petit": Malgré votre ancienneté en tant que chef, vous êtes un constructeur pratique. Vous êtes tout aussi heureux de brainstorm de concepts de plate-forme de haut niveau avec Design que vous êtes de rouler vos manches et de corriger une erreur tech-pack.

• Confortable avec la friction constructive : l'innovation ne se produit pas dans le vide. Vous accueillez diverses perspectives, vous penchez dans un débat sain avec la conception et la gestion du produit, et utilisez le retour pour aiguiser le produit final.

• Apprentissage continu : Le paysage de la chaussure – surtout dans les matériaux durables et la circulaire – évolue quotidiennement. Vous êtes naturellement curieux, constamment à la recherche de nouvelles méthodes, et désireux d'appliquer de nouveaux apprentissages aux lignes PAD et Kids.

jobs.title: Lead - Construction Project Management
jobs.description:
In short:

The Lead - Construction Project Manager will report to the Senior Lead - Construction, on the Real Estate and Development team . You will orchestrate the end-to-end delivery of high-end DTC and B2B stores, showrooms and workplaces. Your strategic impact lies in predicting and safeguarding aggressive opening timelines ( Time ) and strictly predicting and controlling budgets ( Cost ) while championing operational excellence during a phase of internal transformation.

Your Mission:

• Lead End-to-End Retail Deployments: Manage the execution of high-end DTC, B2B, SR and WP construction projects from initial planning to handover, ensuring absolute adherence to tight opening schedules and budget.

• Enforce Phase Separation: Maintain a strict boundary between the Design Phase (collaborating with internal designers to secure early sign-offs ) and the Construction Phase to eliminate late-stage changes that impact delivery.

• Manage External PMs & Vendors: Supervise outsourced Project Managers, General Contractors and many other vendors, serving as the ultimate decision-maker for change orders, timelines, and budgets.

• Champion Cost & Time Control: Act as the key financial and schedule forecaster for your projects, evaluating every on-site challenge through the lens of Time and Cost. Quality is given for granted.

• Drive Internal Stakeholder Satisfaction: Partner closely with internal clients to keep them highly engaged, proactively aligned, and enthusiastic about the construction process and improvement.

• Steer Process Optimization: Contribute actively to our ongoing organizational change by structuring scalable workflows, standardized reporting, and post-project feedback loops.

Your Story:

• Proven Retail Construction Track Record: 10+ years of project management experience delivering premium commercial spaces or flagship retail stores (experience in high-end fit-outs is highly valued).

• Mastery of Time & Cost Forecasting: Demonstrated expertise in rigorous scheduling (e.g., Critical Path Method), budget estimation, and proactive risk management under compressed timelines.

• External Vendor Leadership: Strong experience in sourcing, steering, and holding external PM firms, architects, and general contractors accountable to strict KPIs.

• Stakeholder Management & Empathy: Excellent communication skills with a proven ability to educate, influence, and build trusting relationships with demanding internal business clients.

• Structured & Process-Oriented: A logical mindset capable of establishing clear project milestones, "freeze dates" for design, and structured change-management protocols.

• Academic & Language Credentials: Bachelor’s degree in Architecture, Civil Engineering, or Project Management. Fluency in English is required. Knowledge of other languages spoken in the EMEA region is highly appreciated.

Your Team:

You will join the EMEA Construction team that deeply values the exceptional work accomplished by its members so far. As we enter a refinement phase, we are committed to giving full credit to those who built this department’s success, while strategically complementing their strength with external professionals of recognized expertise. By blending our solid internal foundation with fresh, high-value industry knowledge, we are ready to elevate our retail expansion to the next level.

jobs.title: Lead - Commercialization Engineer

titleByLocale.fr: Chef de Projet - Ingénieur en Commercialisation

jobs.description:
In short:

As a Lead, Innovation commercialization engineer, you will be a driving force at the forefront of On's scale of product evolution. You will operate with a high degree of autonomy to lead complex projects, challenge conventions, and champion innovative approaches that define the future of footwear. This role requires you to master technical complexity, manage key stakeholder relationships, and translate visionary concepts into scalable, performance-driven products.

Your Mission:

• As a leader within the team, you will independently manage multiple high-impact footwear development projects from confirmation to production, defining methods and procedures for new assignments and potentially supervising other team members. As a senior contributor, you will leverage your expertise to guide and influence both management and your team.

• You will spearhead the end-to-end commercialization process, leveraging your expert knowledge of manufacturing processes, fit, material properties, mold and process manufacturing. Your strong root-cause analysis mindset will be crucial in troubleshooting significant and unique issues related to tooling, molding, assembly, fit, and wear.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Designazione delle merci

In breve:

Come ingegnere leader, Innovation Commercialization, sarete una forza trainante all'avanguardia nell'evoluzione dei prodotti di On. Opererete con un alto grado di autonomia per condurre progetti complessi, sfidare convenzioni e sostenere approcci innovativi che definiscono il futuro delle calzature. Questo ruolo richiede di padroneggiare la complessità tecnica, gestire le relazioni chiave degli stakeholder e tradurre concetti visionari in prodotti a scala mobile e basati sulle prestazioni.

La tua missione

- Come leader all'interno del team, gestirai in modo indipendente diversi progetti di sviluppo di calzature ad alto impatto dalla conferma alla produzione, definendo metodi e procedure per nuove assegnazioni e potenzialmente supervisionando altri membri del team. Come collaboratore senior, potrai sfruttare la tua esperienza per guidare e influenzare sia la gestione che il tuo team.

- Avrete la punta del processo di commercializzazione end-to-end, sfruttando la vostra conoscenza esperto di processi di produzione, fit, proprietà dei materiali, muffa e produzione di processo. La vostra forte mentalità di analisi della causa-radice sarà cruciale nella risoluzione dei problemi significativi e unici relativi a utensili, stampaggio, assemblaggio, fit, e usura.

- Come hub centrale per le principali regioni di produzione On.s, agirai come collegamento critico tra team di sviluppo e produzione Online, lavorando a stretto contatto con fornitori strategici per garantire che l'intento del prodotto sia mantenuto, rispettando i requisiti commerciali e operativi. Ingegnererà prodotti per una efficiente capacità di costruzione, costi più bassi e la massima qualità e prestazioni.

- Servirete come un centro di comunicazione centrale e influencer chiave, la gestione delle aspettative e negoziare efficacemente con diversi team interni e con i principali partner esterni T1/T2 e le squadre di approvvigionamento in tutte le regioni.

- Diramando con progettisti computazionali, lavorerete con modelli superiori e regolazioni di costruzione per migliorare la vestibilità, la durata e garantire la produzione di scalabili. Sarete responsabili per la classificazione di funzionamento full size, manuali di funzionamento tecnico, prova di produzione iniziale, aggiornamento del sistema ERP, registrazione della scalabilità, tra gli altri.

- La documentazione relativa a strumenti complessi e questioni di livello superiore sarà vostra, definendo e comunicando a tutti gli stakeholder azioni di correzione chiare per le linee guida di fabbricazione.

La tua storia

- 8+ anni di esperienza progressista nel settore calzaturiero, con un'attenzione significativa all'innovazione e all'introduzione sul mercato di nuove tecnologie.

- Laurea magistrale in Ingegneria, Scienze Materiali o un altro campo tecnico rilevante.

- 2D e 3D, progettazione computazionale e capacità algoritmiche sono un plus.

- la capacità di condurre non solo la scalatura delle nuove tecnologie, ma anche la loro redditività commerciale e la loro disponibilità in fabbrica.

- Conoscenza a livello di esperti dei processi di produzione di calzature avanzate, tra cui robotica, automazione, utensili, stampaggio, iniezione, saldatura, durata e montaggio. Comprendete le capacità, le tolleranze e le limitazioni di fabbrica e sapete come progettare la replicabilità a scala mobile.

- Una curiosità tecnica naturale e un approccio robusto e robusto all'analisi delle cause della risoluzione dei problemi.

- Comunicazione, negoziazione e capacità di influenza eccezionali, con la capacità di presentarsi con fiducia ai dirigenti e ai partner esterni.

- Una capacità dimostrata di lavorare con un alto grado di autonomia, navigando nell'ambiguità e pronunciando giudizi indipendenti su questioni complesse e significative.

- L'esperienza in mentoring giovani membri del team o supervisione attività del progetto è un vantaggio forte.

- Possibilità di viaggiare fino al 15-20% del tempo.

La tua squadra

On's Innovation team è un gruppo interdisciplinare di produttori di calzature, produttori avanzati e futuri esperti sportivi, che guidano le innovazioni future di On e tecnologie athlete-informate che separano le calzature.

Sfidiamo lo status quo e spiniamo i confini verso l'innovazione pioniere delle calzature. Come membro del team On Innovation, penserete fuori dagli schemi e porterete alla vita nuove idee innovative.

Warenbezeichnung

Kurz gesagt:

Als Lead, Innovations-Commanderization-Ingenieur, werden Sie eine treibende Kraft an der Spitze der On-Skala der Produktentwicklung. Sie werden mit einem hohen Grad an Autonomie zu arbeiten, um komplexe Projekte zu führen, Herausforderung Konventionen, und die Innovationsansätze, die die Zukunft der Schuhe definieren. Diese Rolle erfordert es, technische Komplexität zu meistern, Management Schlüssel Stakeholder-Beziehungen und übersetzen visionäre Konzepte in skalierbare, leistungsorientierte Produkte.

Ihre Mission

- Als Führungskraft im Team verwalten Sie unabhängig von der Bestätigung bis zur Produktion mehrere hochwirksame Schuhentwicklungsprojekte, definieren Methoden und Verfahren für neue Aufgaben und überwachen möglicherweise andere Teammitglieder. Als Senior-Beitrager nutzen Sie Ihre Expertise, um das Management und Ihr Team zu leiten und zu beeinflussen.

- Sie werden die Speerspitze der End-to-End-Commancialization Prozess, die Nutzung Ihrer Expertenwissen über Herstellungsverfahren, Passform, Materialeigenschaften, Form-und Prozess-Fertigung. Ihre starke Wurzel-Ursache Analyse Mindset wird entscheidend bei der Fehlersuche wichtige und einzigartige Probleme im Zusammenhang mit Werkzeugen, Formgebung, Montage, Passform und Verschleiß.

- Als zentrale Drehscheibe für On,s wichtige Produktionsregionen, werden Sie als eine kritische Verbindung zwischen On Inline Entwicklungs- und Produktionsteams, eng mit strategischen Anbietern zu arbeiten, um sicherzustellen, dass Produktabsichten beibehalten werden, während kommerzielle und betriebliche Anforderungen erfüllt werden. Sie werden Produkte für effiziente Manufakturierbarkeit, niedrigste Kosten und höchste Qualität und Leistung zu konstruieren.

- Sie werden als zentrales Kommunikationszentrum und Influencer fungieren, um Erwartungen zu managen und mit verschiedenen internen Teams und wichtigen externen T1/T2-Partnern und Teams in allen Regionen effektiv zu verhandeln.

- In Zusammenarbeit mit Computerdesignern arbeiten Sie mit oberen Mustern und Werkzeugbau-Anpassungen, um die Passform, Haltbarkeit und eine skalierbare Fertigung zu verbessern. Sie sind verantwortlich für die Full-Size-Lauf-Sortierung, technische Fertigung Betriebsanleitungen, erste Produktionsprobe, ERP-System-Update, Skalierbarkeitssign off, unter anderem.

- Sie werden die Dokumentation komplexer Werkzeuge und übergeordneter Themen besitzen, indem Sie klare Korrekturmaßnahmen für die Herstellungsrichtlinien an alle Beteiligten definieren und kommunizieren.

Ihre Geschichte

- 8+ Jahre fortschrittliche Erfahrung in der Schuhindustrie, mit einem bedeutenden Fokus auf Innovation und die Markteinführung neuer Technologien.

- Bachelor, Master oder Master in Ingenieurwesen, Materialwissenschaft oder einem anderen relevanten technischen Bereich.

- 2D und 3D, Rechendesign und algorithmische Fähigkeiten sind ein Plus.

- Bewährte Fähigkeit, nicht nur die Skalierung neuer Technologien zu führen, sondern auch ihre wirtschaftliche Lebensfähigkeit und Fabrikbereitschaft zu bewerten.

- Expertenwissen über fortgeschrittene Schuhherstellungsprozesse, einschließlich Robotik, Automatisierung, Werkzeugbau, Formgebung, Spritzguss, Schweißen, Dauer- und Montage. Sie verstehen die Fähigkeiten, Toleranzen und Grenzen der Fabrik und wissen, wie Sie für skalierbare Replikationen zu entwickeln sind.

- Eine natürliche technische Neugier und ein robuster, wurzel-herausragender Ansatz zur Problemlösung.

- Außergewöhnliche Kommunikation, Verhandlungen und Einflussnahme von Fähigkeiten, mit der Fähigkeit, Senior Management und externen Partnern vertrauensvoll zu präsentieren.

- eine nachgewiesene Fähigkeit, mit einem hohen Grad an Autonomie zu arbeiten, Unklarheiten zu navigieren und unabhängige Urteile in komplexen und wichtigen Fragen zu treffen.

- Erfahrung in der Betreuung von Nachwuchsteammitgliedern oder der Überwachung von Projektaktivitäten ist ein starkes Plus.

- Fähigkeit, bis zu 15-20% der Zeit zu reisen.

Ihr Team

On's Innovation Team ist eine agile, interdisziplinäre Gruppe von Schuhkreation, fortschrittliche Fertigung und Zukunft von Sportexperten, die On's zukünftige Innovationen und athletic-informed Technologien, die auf Schuhe auseinander.

Wir fordern den Status quo heraus und schieben Grenzen für Pionier-Innovationen im Schuhwerk. Als Mitglied des On Innovation Teams werden Sie über den Tellerrand hinaus denken und neue, innovative Ideen zum Leben erwecken.
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Désignation des marchandises

En bref:

En tant que chef de file, ingénieur en commercialisation de l'innovation, vous serez un moteur de l'évolution des produits à l'échelle d'On. Vous travaillerez avec une grande autonomie pour diriger des projets complexes, des conventions de challenge et des approches innovantes qui définissent l'avenir de la chaussure. Ce rôle vous oblige à maîtriser la complexité technique, gérer les relations avec les intervenants clés et traduire des concepts visionnaires en produits évolutifs et axés sur la performance.

Votre mission

- En tant que leader au sein de l'équipe, vous gérerez de façon indépendante plusieurs projets de développement de chaussures à impact élevé, de la confirmation à la production, en définissant les méthodes et les procédures pour les nouvelles affectations et en supervisant éventuellement d'autres membres de l'équipe.

- Vous serez le fer de lance du processus de commercialisation de bout en bout, en tirant parti de votre connaissance experte des processus de fabrication, de l'ajustement, des propriétés des matériaux, des moules et de la fabrication de processus.

- En tant que centre central pour les régions manufacturières clés d'On, vous agirez comme une liaison critique entre les équipes de développement et de production Online, en travaillant étroitement avec les fournisseurs stratégiques pour assurer le maintien de l'intention du produit tout en répondant aux exigences commerciales et opérationnelles.

- Vous serez un pôle central de communication et de polarisation, gérerez les attentes et négocierez efficacement avec diverses équipes internes et les principaux partenaires externes T1/T2 et équipes de sourcing dans toutes les régions.

- En collaboration avec les concepteurs de calcul, vous travaillerez avec des modèles supérieurs et des ajustements de construction d'outillage pour améliorer l'ajustement, la durabilité et assurer la fabrication évolutive. Vous serez responsable du classement complet, des manuels techniques de fabrication, de l'essai de production initial, de la mise à jour du système ERP, de l'approbation de l'évolutivité, entre autres.

- Vous posséderez la documentation d'outils complexes et de questions supérieures, en définissant et en communiquant des mesures de correction claires à tous les intervenants pour les lignes directrices de fabrication.

Votre histoire

- 8 ans et plus d'expérience progressive dans l'industrie de la chaussure, avec un accent important sur l'innovation et l'introduction de nouvelles technologies sur le marché.

- Baccalauréat ou maîtrise en ingénierie, sciences des matériaux ou autre domaine technique pertinent.

- 2D et 3D, conception informatique et capacités algorithmiques sont un plus.

- Être en mesure non seulement de diriger l'échelle des nouvelles technologies, mais aussi d'évaluer leur viabilité commerciale et leur capacité d'usine.

- Connaissances spécialisées des processus de fabrication de chaussures avancés, y compris la robotique, l'automatisation, l'outillage, le moulage, l'injection, le soudage, la durabilité et l'assemblage.

- Une curiosité technique naturelle et une approche solide et basée sur l'analyse de la cause profonde pour résoudre les problèmes.

- Communication, négociation et compétences exceptionnelles, avec la capacité de présenter en toute confiance aux cadres supérieurs et aux partenaires externes.

- Une capacité démontrée de travailler avec une grande autonomie, de naviguer dans l'ambiguïté et de faire des jugements indépendants sur des questions complexes et importantes.

- L'expérience en mentorat des membres de l'équipe junior ou en supervision des activités de projet est un atout.

- Capacité de voyager jusqu'à 15-20 % du temps.

Votre équipe

L'équipe Innovation d'On est un groupe de création de chaussures, de fabrication avancée et d'avenir des experts du sport, qui pilote les innovations futures d'On et les technologies adaptées aux athlètes qui mettent les chaussures à part.

Nous défions le statu quo et repoussons les frontières pour faire de l'innovation dans le domaine de la chaussure un pionnier. En tant que membre de l'équipe On Innovation, vous réfléchirez en dehors de la boîte et vous donnerez vie à de nouvelles idées novatrices.

jobs.title: Lead - Apparel Testing
jobs.description:
In short

Product Testing is the voice of the athlete and the consumer at On. We ensure every product delivers a premium, high-performance experience by combining scientific rigor with real-world insight.

As Apparel and Accessories Testing Lead, you will be responsible for validating products from development through to market, focusing on specialized, high performance sport categories. You’ll work in a fast-paced, collaborative environment and act as a key partner across Design, Development, Materials, and Strategy to ensure excellence in the wearing experience including comfort, durability, and performance.

Your mission

Command the Validation Strategy: Define and execute rigorous testing strategies across durability, comfort, and performance, taking charge of specialized testing programs. You will identify testing requirements based on product briefs and target consumers, confidently owning the end-to-end testing process.

Uncover the Truth in Data: Lead qualitative and quantitative apparel and accessories testing, perception studies, and real-world validation to ensure our products reflect authentic athlete and consumer needs. Integrate consumer insights, scientific expertise, and performance analysis into standardized, evidence-based product evaluations.

Drive Confident Decisions: Translate complex testing results into powerful insights that enable confident decision-making and elevate product excellence across the organization. You will analyze performance and durability data, including behavior and attitudinal insights, developing clear reports for project stakeholders.

Influence Product Creation: Conduct hands-on performance testing, directly presenting key findings and improvement recommendations to critical stakeholders. Deliver benchmarking and competitor insights to spot opportunities for true innovation and product differentiation in the global sports arena.

Build the Testing Ecosystem: Establish highly efficient testing processes, timelines, and feedback loops aligned seamlessly with Product Creation calendars. You will actively build and maintain a dynamic tester network of agile, high-performance athletes that supports both everyday testing needs and urgent project timelines. Set up high-energy testing events and initiatives to drive deep engagement within the testing community.

Elevate Operations: Work seamlessly with testing systems and databases to ensure accurate, high-quality data and optimized reporting flows. As a leader, you will contribute significantly to team goals, process improvements, and the continuous evolution of our testing methodologies.

Your story

• A strategic thinker and natural leader with a proven track record of managing complex projects or product validation cycles from concept to market.

• You possess a deep understanding of specialized, high-performance sports apparel and accessories, and know how to balance scientific testing rigor with real-world, human-centric feedback.

• You are an exceptional communicator who can translate dense data and testing metrics into clear, actionable recommendations to cross-functional teams

• You are highly organized and capable of building out robust tester networks, establishing efficient processes, and managing global testing logistics.

• You have 7+ years of experience in a field focused on the human experience with a product or service. We are excited to hear from candidates from diverse backgrounds, including but not limited to:

• Apparel Product Testing or Development

• User Experience Research (UXR)

• Biomechanics or Kinesiology

• Materials Science or Textile Engineering

• Ergonomics or Human Factors

• Sports Marketing or Athlete Management

• High-Performance Coaching

• You are willing to travel globally and have the flexibility to work outside of typical hours to align with athlete schedules and events.

• A clear communicator in English, both verbal and written.

Your Team

You'll be a leader in a global team fueled by a culture of relentless discovery. We test and validate our product promises, transforming athlete feedback and scientific data into market-leading performance. While our creation partners work to make products great, our mission is to prove they're great. Based in Zurich, our team of Footwear, Apparel & Accessories, and Lab experts is the ultimate destination for individuals dedicated to enhancing the consumer experience.

As Apparel and Accessories Testing Lead, you will be responsible for validating products from development through to market, focusing on specialized, high performance sport categories. You’ll work in a fast-paced, collaborative environment and act as a key partner across Design, Development, Materials, and Strategy to ensure excellence in the wearing experience including comfort, durability, and performance. Your mission Command the Validation Strategy: Define and execute rigorous testing strategies across durability, comfort, and performance, taking charge of specialized testing programs. You will identify testing requirements based on product briefs and target consumers, confidently owning the end-to-end testing process. Uncover the Truth in Data: Lead qualitative and quantitative apparel and accessories testing, perception studies, and real-world validation to ensure our products reflect authentic athlete and consumer needs. Integrate consumer insights, scientific expertise, and performance analysis into standardized, evidence-based product evaluations. Drive Confident Decisions: Translate complex testing results into powerful insights that enable confident decision-making and elevate product excellence across the organization. You will analyze performance and durability data, including behavior and attitudinal insights, developing clear reports for project stakeholders. Influence Product Creation: Conduct hands-on performance testing, directly presenting key findings and improvement recommendations to critical stakeholders. Deliver benchmarking and competitor insights to spot opportunities for true innovation and product differentiation in the global sports arena. Build the Testing Ecosystem: Establish highly efficient testing processes, timelines, and feedback loops aligned seamlessly with Product Creation calendars. You will actively build and maintain a dynamic tester network of agile, high-performance athletes that supports both everyday testing needs and urgent project timelines. Set up high-energy testing events and initiatives to drive deep engagement within the testing community. Elevate Operations: Work seamlessly with testing systems and databases to ensure accurate, high-quality data and optimized reporting flows. As a leader, you will contribute significantly to team goals, process improvements, and the continuous evolution of our testing methodologies. Your story
• A strategic thinker and natural leader with a proven track record of managing complex projects or product validation cycles from concept to market.
• You possess a deep understanding of specialized, high-performance sports apparel and accessories, and know how to balance scientific testing rigor with real-world, human-centric feedback.
• You are an exceptional communicator who can translate dense data and testing metrics into clear, actionable recommendations to cross-functional teams
• You are highly organized and capable of building out robust tester networks, establishing efficient processes, and managing global testing logistics.
• You have 7+ years of experience in a field focused on the human experience with a product or service. We are excited to hear from candidates from diverse backgrounds, including but not limited to:
• Apparel Product Testing or Development
• User Experience Research (UXR)
• Biomechanics or Kinesiology
• Materials Science or Textile Engineering
• Ergonomics or Human Factors
• Sports Marketing or Athlete Management
• High-Performance Coaching
• You are willing to travel globally and have the flexibility to work outside of typical hours to align with athlete schedules and events.
• A clear communicator in English, both verbal and written. Your Team You'll be a leader in a global team fueled by a culture of relentless discovery. We test and validate our product promises, transforming athlete feedback and scientific data into market-leading performance. While our creation partners work to make products great, our mission is to prove they're great. Based in Zurich, our team of Footwear, Apparel & Accessories, and Lab experts is the ultimate destination for individuals dedicated to enhancing the consumer experience.

jobs.title: Intern - EMEA Sales Planning
jobs.description:
In short

Whether you’re looking to jump start your career or gain first hands-on experience in a new field, an internship at On offers you a unique growth experience, the chance to make an impact from day one and contribute to On’s growth journey. We are looking for fresh ideas, curious minds and passionate individuals ready to make a difference. Our internships generally last six months and you will be fully embedded in a team.

- Start date: March 1st 2026
- Duration: Six months
- Prerequisite: Interest in area relevant to the internship, passion for On, right to work in EU / Switzerland
- Note: This is a paid internship
- If you don't meet the criteria above, unfortunately, we cannot move forward with your application. Please be truthful in your answers, the recruiter reviewing your application will appreciate your honesty.

Curious about life as an intern at On? We recommend watching the recording of our previous livestream ( https://www.careerfairy.io/company/On_AG/livestream/eCaoLI8t0mYLqzRYM1eq ) to hear former interns share their internship experience, get an insider’s look at different departments and pick up some tips and tricks from our recruiters to help you ace the application process.

Meet the team

The Sales Planning team within the EMEA Wholesale department plays a key role in driving the business from long-range financial forecasting to monthly sales planning. The team manages in-season performance to ensure targets are met and supports pre-season assortment planning to optimize product and Accounts strategies. Working cross-functionally with Sales, Controlling, Demand Planning, and Operations, the team ensures alignment between commercial goals and operational execution. It is an innovative and constantly evolving function, continuously improving processes and tools to enhance business performance and agility.

Your mission

• Perform weekly business analyses and generate actionable insights to support the Sales and Management teams in decision-making.

• Contribute to sales planning activities, including financial forecasting, in-season tracking, and pre-season assortment planning.

• Enhance and develop analytical tools and files (e.g., sell-out dashboards, forecast roll-ups, invoice trackers, G2N by region/sub-region) to enable more data-driven sales decisions.

• Support and drive sales-related projects aimed at improving processes, tools, and overall department efficiency.

• Support on developing AI capabilities within the commercial function.

Your story

• Demonstrate a proactive and entrepreneurial mindset, taking initiative and ownership of tasks with a “can-do” attitude.

• You have strong analytical skills and a data-driven approach to support decision-making and identify business opportunities.

• A natural problem solver, able to navigate ambiguity and find creative, practical solutions.

• Curious and eager to learn, showing genuine interest in understanding sales processes and business dynamics.

• You think outside the box and embrace challenges beyond your comfort zone to drive innovation and continuous improvement.

What we offer

On is a place that is centered around growth and progress. We offer an environment designed to give people the tools to develop holistically – to stay active, to learn, explore and innovate. Our distinctive approach combines a supportive, team-oriented atmosphere, with access to personal self-care for both physical and mental well-being, so each person is led by purpose.

jobs.title: Head of Strategy & Operations, Footwear Product Creation

titleByLocale.it: Responsabile Strategy & Operations, Footwear Product Creation
titleByLocale.en: Head of Strategy & Operations, Footwear Product Creation
titleByLocale.de: Leiter Strategy & Operations, Footwear Product Creation
titleByLocale.fr: Responsable Strategy & Operations, Footwear Product Creation

jobs.description:
In short

As the Head of Strategy & Operations, you are the architect of Footwear Creation's operating model. You will translate On's 2030 Long Range Plan into executable transformation- driving the strategic initiatives, processes, and systems that enable our team to deliver breakthrough footwear with Swiss-engineered precision. Sitting at the intersection of Development, Engineering, Materials, and Sustainability, you will influence leaders across functions, build organizational excitement for new ways of working, and make decisive calls on initiative prioritization and execution. Your mission: own the LRP initiative portfolio, orchestrate the leadership operating rhythm, and deliver measurable transformation that elevates how we create.

Your mission

Strategic Leadership & Vision (LRP to Action)

• Architect the Roadmap: Translate On’s 2030 LRP and annual goals into a multi-year strategic roadmap for Footwear Product Creation

• Strategic Prioritization: Act as the Creation gatekeeper for the footwear portfolio, ensuring technical breakthroughs are sequenced and resourced for maximum commercial impact.

Portfolio Strategy & Operating Rhythm

• Own seasonal range portfolio planning: capacity modeling, resource allocation, project prioritization

• Design and manage the Footwear Creation operating rhythm: weekly leadership standups, monthly business reviews, quarterly strategic planning

• Facilitate high-stakes leadership discussions; Own the agendas, pre-reads, drive decisions and follow-through for all leadership forums

• Serve as the primary coordination point between Creation and cross-functional partners (Innovation, Sourcing, Brand, Supply Chain)

• Build portfolio dashboards that give leadership real-time visibility into capacity, progress, risks, and trade-offs.

Process Excellence & Transformation

• Lead strategic initiatives to improve creation velocity: stage-gate optimization, systems integration, capacity planning frameworks

• Identify and eliminate process inefficiencies; challenge any workflow that doesn't add value

• Drive adoption of new ways of working through clear metrics, change management, and feedback loops

• Build a high-accountability, fast-decision culture within the Creation leadership team.

Change Management & Adoption Excellence

• Drive adoption of new initiatives through comprehensive change management: communication strategies, training programs, adoption metrics, feedback mechanisms

• Build organizational excitement and understanding of the strategic rationale behind transformational changes

• Navigate politics and complexity to drive decisions and unblock progress

• Hold partners accountable to commitments- even when they don't report to you

• Monitor leading indicators of adoption; implement course corrections when resistance or confusion emerges

• Foster a culture of accountability, transparency, and continuous improvement within Footwear Creation.

Your Story

• Experience: 10+ years of leadership in Product Strategy, Program Management, or Footwear Creation, with a proven track record of translating corporate strategy into actionable cross-functional initiatives

• Operational Rigor: Exceptional executive facilitation skills; you are comfortable holding senior stakeholders accountable and running high-stakes leadership rhythms

• Influence without authority: You've led initiatives where success required getting leaders who don't report to you to change how they work. You have low self orientation

• Footwear Acumen: Deep understanding of the end-to-end product creation lifecycle- from innovation and engineering to global manufacturing

• Data-Driven Mindset: Exceptional analytical and visualization skills; you can turn complex project data into clear insights for executive decision-making

• Transformation Leader: Experience leading organizational change, including "Future State" org design and the implementation of new operating models

• Communication: A natural storyteller, capable of inspiring large teams on stage and navigating complex cross-functional partnerships

• Passion: An undeniable drive for sports, footwear technology, and Swiss-engineered innovation.

Why This Matters

On is scaling fast. Footwear Creation needs to evolve- not just work harder, but work smarter. We need new systems, new processes, new ways of collaborating. We need someone who can drive that transformation across a complex, cross-functional organization.

You won't build the products. But you'll build the operating model, the systems, and the culture that enable products and brand initiatives to be adopted and built with excellence, at speed, at scale.

If you're the kind of transformation leader who thrives on complexity, who knows how to influence without authority, who can make tough calls and drive change that sticks- this is your role.

Meet The Team

Our mission is to define and create the future of sportswear bringing to life groundbreaking innovations. Acting at the forefront of material science, sport science and engineering we develop products that push the boundaries of performance and sustainability, blending in unique aesthetic appeal that embodies On’s design DNA.

What we offer

On is a place that is centered around growth and progress. We offer an environment designed to give people the tools to develop holistically – to stay active, to learn, explore and innovate. Our distinctive approach combines a supportive, team-oriented atmosphere, with access to personal self-care for both physical and mental well-being, so each person is led by purpose.

On is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to creating a work environment that is fair and inclusive, where all decisions related to recruitment, advancement, and retention are free of discrimination.

• Facilitate high-stakes leadership discussions; Own the agendas, pre-reads, drive decisions and follow-through for all leadership forums

• Serve as the primary coordination point between Creation and cross-functional partners (Innovation, Sourcing, Brand, Supply Chain)

• Build portfolio dashboards that give leadership real-time visibility into capacity, progress, risks, and trade-offs.

Process Excellence & Transformation

• Lead strategic initiatives to improve creation velocity: stage-gate optimization, systems integration, capacity planning frameworks

• Identify and eliminate process inefficiencies; challenge any workflow that doesn't add value

• Drive adoption of new ways of working through clear metrics, change management, and feedback loops

• Build a high-accountability, fast-decision culture within the Creation leadership team.

Change Management & Adoption Excellence

• Drive adoption of new initiatives through comprehensive change management: communication strategies, training programs, adoption metrics, feedback mechanisms

• Build organizational excitement and understanding of the strategic rationale behind transformational changes

• Navigate politics and complexity to drive decisions and unblock progress

• Hold partners accountable to commitments- even when they don't report to you

• Monitor leading indicators of adoption; implement course corrections when resistance or confusion emerges

• Foster a culture of accountability, transparency, and continuous improvement within Footwear Creation.

Your Story

• Experience: 10+ years of leadership in Product Strategy, Program Management, or Footwear Creation, with a proven track record of translating corporate strategy into actionable cross-functional initiatives

• Operational Rigor: Exceptional executive facilitation skills; you are comfortable holding senior stakeholders accountable and running high-stakes leadership rhythms

• Influence without authority: You've led initiatives where success required getting leaders who don't report to you to change how they work. You have low self orientation

• Footwear Acumen: Deep understanding of the end-to-end product creation lifecycle- from innovation and engineering to global manufacturing

• Data-Driven Mindset: Exceptional analytical and visualization skills; you can turn complex project data into clear insights for executive decision-making

• Transformation Leader: Experience leading organizational change, including "Future State" org design and the implementation of new operating models

• Communication: A natural storyteller, capable of inspiring large teams on stage and navigating complex cross-functional partnerships

• Passion: An undeniable drive for sports, footwear technology, and Swiss-engineered innovation.

Why This Matters

On is scaling fast. Footwear Creation needs to evolve- not just work harder, but work smarter. We need new systems, new processes, new ways of collaborating. We need someone who can drive that transformation across a complex, cross-functional organization.

You won't build the products. But you'll build the operating model, the systems, and the culture that enable products and brand initiatives to be adopted and built with excellence, at speed, at scale.

If you're the kind of transformation leader who thrives on complexity, who knows how to influence without authority, who can make tough calls and drive change that sticks- this is your role.

Meet The Team

Our mission is to define and create the future of sportswear bringing to life groundbreaking innovations. Acting at the forefront of material science, sport science and engineering we develop products that push the boundaries of performance and sustainability, blending in unique aesthetic appeal that embodies On’s design DNA.

What we offer

On is a place that is centered around growth and progress. We offer an environment designed to give people the tools to develop holistically – to stay active, to learn, explore and innovate. Our distinctive approach combines a supportive, team-oriented atmosphere, with access to personal self-care for both physical and mental well-being, so each person is led by purpose.

On is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to creating a work environment that is fair and inclusive, where all decisions related to recruitment, advancement, and retention are free of discrimination.

jobs.title: Head of Product Development | Accessories
jobs.description:
In short

We are looking for a visionary and technically proficient Head of Product Development | to lead our accessories product engine. This is a critical leadership role where you will be responsible for translating creative concepts into highly functional, durable, and commercially viable (technical) performance and lifestyle accessories. You will lead a high-performing team, drive product innovation, and own the development process from initial prototyping to final production, ensuring the highest standards of quality, performance, and sustainability. This role will report into the Global Senior Director of Product Creation + Sourcing.

Your mission

Your mission is to execute the accessories development strategy and roadmap aligned with the overall brand, product, and financial goals. You will oversee development and successful commercialization from ideation to launch, including engineering, sampling, testing, milestone management, and final specifications. You will deliver against gross margin targets, manage department budgets while optimising costs. You will also provide collaborative leadership to align teams and foster an innovative work environment that encourages creativity, risk-taking and continuous improvement.

Key Responsibilities

• Execute overall accessories development strategy and map out a roadmap which aligns with the overall brand, product, and financial goals

• Oversee all development and ensure commercialization of the product range from ideation to launch, including development engineering, sampling, testing, milestone management, and final product specifications

• Work as a partner to Design, Materials, Innovation, Product Management, and Sourcing teams to ensure successful delivery of seasonal products and execute strategic vision for the business

• Deliver against gross margin targets and manage department budgets while optimizing on costs

• Conduct comprehensive market research to identify emerging trends, competitive threats, and new market opportunities

• Support and partner with our Sourcing teams in Asia & Europe on building a robust global sourcing strategy that emphasises high-quality products, world-class partnerships, service, ethical sourcing and sustainability

• Implement supply chain initiatives, in partnership with our ESG team, that reduce environmental impact, such as using recycled and preferred materials, advanced water treatment and color dyeing technologies and optimising logistics with initiatives like localisation

• Stay at the forefront of emerging technologies and market trends to identify and oversee the development of innovative accessories that meet performance, durability, and sustainability requirements, which will instigate new ways of thinking about products

• Establish and enforce rigorous product testing and quality control protocols to ensure compliance with industry standards and brand requirements

• Spearhead and streamline product development and manufacturing processes to increase efficiency, reduce complexity and time to market

• Build and maintain strong relationships with key suppliers, engage with industry stakeholders, including athletes and sports professionals and work with the cross-functional stakeholders to gather customer feedback and incorporate it into future product designs.

Your story

• 15+ years of experience in accessories (hard and soft goods), including at least 7 years in a senior leadership role.

• Hold a deep understanding of sports accessory trends and competitor landscapes, with a proven ability to identify and capitalise on market opportunities, to drive growth and innovation within the accessories category

• Proven track record of successful team leadership and the ability to inspire and motivate a diverse group of professionals, ability to influence stakeholders, and to translate technical complexities for non-technical audiences

• Expert knowledge of technical textiles, manufacturing processes, and "design for manufacturing" principles, alongside proficiency in the latest creation software.

• A strong commitment to sustainability and a history of implementing sustainability initiatives in product development and sourcing

• Experienced in global supply chain management, optimising processes for efficiency, cost reduction, and quality

• Familiarity with the latest creation software and technologies relevant to accessory design, development and production.

What we offer

On is a place that is centered around growth and progress. We offer an environment designed to give people the tools to develop holistically- to stay active, to learn, explore and innovate. Our distinctive approach combines a supportive, team-oriented atmosphere with access to personal self-care for both physical and mental well-being, so each person is led by purpose.

On is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to creating a work environment that is fair and inclusive, where all decisions related to recruitment, advancement, and retention are free of discrimination.

jobs.title: Head of Merchandising Planning, EMEA
jobs.description:
In short

As the Head of Merchandising Planning EMEA, you will be the strategic visionary leading our merchandising planning function across the region. You will architect the planning strategy that powers our commercial success, ensuring our product vision translates seamlessly into data-driven, highly accurate, and scalable financial and inventory plans.
By building cutting-edge frameworks and leveraging advanced technologies, you will empower your team—including the Merchandising Planning Leads—to drive operational excellence. You are a key leadership partner, integrating planning insights into the broader Go-To-Market (GTM) strategy bridging the gap between global product intent and regional market reality, and aligning our multi-channel execution across Wholesale, Digital, and Retail.

Your mission

• Cross- Channel Stakeholder Leadership: Lead and manage cross-functional stakeholder relationships, acting as the key strategic partner to channel leaders and Sales Planning leaders across Wholesale, DtC-Ecom, and DtC-Retail to ensure unified commercial execution and end-2-end planning.

• Strategic Frameworks: Set the overarching framework and define the ways of working for product level planning in Long Range Plan (LRP), pre-season planning, and in-season management & IBP cycle, ensuring robust real-time forecasts at the vertical, collection, and product franchise levels.

• Forecasting Optimization: Increase forecast accuracy metrics and minimize missed sales opportunities. You will achieve this by smartly and swiftly translating sell-through trends and market insights into dynamic adjustments of plans and open-to-buy forecasts.

• AI-Enabled Smart Planning: Champion the adoption and integration of AI and advanced data analytics into our planning processes to enable smart planning, optimize inventory flow, and enhance predictive decision-making capabilities across the region.

• Team Leadership & Upskilling: Directly manage, mentor, and inspire a high-performing team of Merchandising Planning Leads, fostering a culture of data-driven accountability and operational excellence.

Your story

• 8+ years of progressive leadership experience in merchandise planning, forecasting, or commercial strategy, preferably within the footwear, sportswear, or fashion industries.

• Strong technical acumen, with a deep understanding of data architecture and hands-on experience leveraging AI planning tools and advanced forecasting models to drive business results.

• Proven track record of setting complex merchandising financial targets, managing multi-channel forecasting processes, and balancing financial, consumer, and operational considerations at a regional scale.

• Exceptional stakeholder management and executive presence, with the ability to influence cross-functional teams and senior leadership globally and regionally.

• An entrepreneurial mindset - you are comfortable navigating structured and unstructured planning challenges, leading teams through ambiguity, and acting autonomously to drive the business forward.

• A positive attitude with outstanding interpersonal and leadership skills. Fluent in English (written and verbal), with additional languages considered a plus.

Meet the team

You will lead the EMEA Merchandising Planning team and work alongside key leadership functions across B2B sales, eCom and Retail, and demand planning with a clear focus on product lifecycle and profitability. In particular, you will partner with the Planning leaders across regional and global teams - Demand Planning, Sales Planning, DtC Buying & Planning, and Controlling teams. As your work is highly strategic and cross-functional, you will also partner closely with our Global Product, Merchandising, and Operations teams. Your team will consist of planning leads and specialists focussed on both footwear and apparel.

What we offer

On is a place that is centered around growth and progress. We offer an environment designed to give people the tools to develop holistically – to stay active, to learn, explore and innovate. Our distinctive approach combines a supportive, team-oriented atmosphere, with access to personal self-care for both physical and mental well-being, so each person is led by purpose.

On is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to creating a work environment that is fair and inclusive, where all decisions related to recruitment, advancement, and retention are free of discrimination.

Lo raggiungerete traducendo in modo intelligente e rapido le tendenze di vendita e le intuizioni di mercato in regolazioni dinamiche di piani e previsioni aperte.

• Team Leadership & Upskilling: Direttamente gestire, mentore e ispirare un team altamente performante di Merchandising Planning Leads, promuovendo una cultura della responsabilità basata sui dati e dell'eccellenza operativa.

La tua storia

• 8+ anni di progressiva esperienza di leadership nella pianificazione della merce, previsione o strategia commerciale, preferibilmente all'interno delle industrie di calzature, abbigliamento sportivo o moda.

• Forte acume tecnico, con una profonda comprensione dell'architettura dei dati e esperienza pratica sfruttando strumenti di pianificazione AI e modelli di previsione avanzati per guidare i risultati aziendali.

• Rilevato tracciato di impostazione di obiettivi finanziari complessi merchandising, gestione di processi di previsione multicanale, e bilanciamento delle considerazioni finanziarie, di consumo e operative su scala regionale.

• Eccezionale gestione delle parti interessate e presenza esecutiva, con la capacità di influenzare team interfunzionali e leadership senior a livello globale e regionale.

• Una mentalità imprenditoriale - si sono confortevoli navigare strutturato e sfide di pianificazione non strutturate, leader team attraverso l'ambiguità, e agire autonomamente per guidare il business avanti.

• Un atteggiamento positivo con eccezionali capacità interpersonali e di leadership. Fluente in inglese (scritto e verbale), con lingue aggiuntive considerate un plus.

Incontra la squadra

Condurrai il team di EMEA Merchandising Planning e lavorerai a fianco delle principali funzioni di leadership tra le vendite di B2B, eCom e Retail e la pianificazione della domanda con una chiara attenzione al ciclo di vita e alla redditività del prodotto. In particolare, sarete partner con i leader di pianificazione tra le squadre regionali e globali - Pianificazione della domanda, Pianificazione delle vendite, DtC Buy & Planning e Controlling team. Poiché il vostro lavoro è altamente strategico e interfunzionale, sarete anche partner a stretto contatto con i nostri team Global Product, Merchandising e Operations. Il vostro team sarà composto da lead di pianificazione e specialisti focalizzati sia sulle calzature che sull'abbigliamento.

Cosa offriamo

Su è un luogo che si concentra intorno alla crescita e al progresso. Offriamo un ambiente progettato per dare alle persone gli strumenti per sviluppare olistico - per rimanere attivo, imparare, esplorare e innovare. Il nostro approccio distintivo combina un'atmosfera solida e orientata al team, con l'accesso all'autocura personale sia per il benessere fisico che mentale, quindi ogni persona è guidata dallo scopo.

Su è una parità di opportunità datori di lavoro. Ci impegniamo a creare un ambiente di lavoro equo e inclusivo, dove tutte le decisioni relative al reclutamento, all'avanzamento e alla conservazione sono libere di discriminazione.
