descriptionByLocale.de:
Kurz gesagt

Als Head of Merchandising Planning EMEA werden Sie der strategische Visionär sein, der unsere Merchandising-Planungsfunktion in der gesamten Region leitet. Sie werden die Planungsstrategie entwerfen, die unseren kommerziellen Erfolg unterstützt und sicherstellen, dass unsere Produktvision nahtlos in datengesteuerte, hochgenaue und skalierbare Finanz- und Inventarpläne umgesetzt wird.
Durch den Aufbau modernster Frameworks und die Nutzung fortschrittlicher Technologien befähigen Sie Ihr Team - einschließlich der Merchandising Planning Leads -, operative Exzellenz zu fördern. Sie sind ein wichtiger Führungspartner, der Planungserkenntnisse in die breitere Go-To-Market (GTM)-Strategie integriert, die die Lücke zwischen globaler Produktabsicht und regionaler Marktrealität schließt und unsere Multi-Channel-Ausführung auf Wholesale, Digital und Retail ausrichtet.

Deine Mission

• Cross-Channel Stakeholder Leadership: Führen und verwalten Sie funktionsübergreifende Stakeholder-Beziehungen und fungieren Sie als wichtiger strategischer Partner für Channel Leader und Sales Planning Leader in Wholesale, DtC-Ecom und DtC-Retail, um eine einheitliche kommerzielle Ausführung und End-2-End-Planung zu gewährleisten.

• Strategische Rahmenbedingungen: Legen Sie den übergreifenden Rahmen fest und definieren Sie die Arbeitsweise für die Produktebenenplanung in Long Range Plan (LRP), Vorsaisonplanung und In-Saison-Management & IBP-Zyklus, um robuste Echtzeitprognosen auf vertikaler, Sammlungs- und Produkt-Franchise-Ebene zu gewährleisten.

• Prognoseoptimierung: Steigern Sie die Genauigkeit von Prognosen und minimieren Sie verpasste Verkaufschancen. Dies erreichen Sie, indem Sie Sell-Through-Trends und Markteinblicke intelligent und schnell in dynamische Anpassungen von Plänen und Open-to-Buy-Prognosen übersetzen.

• AI-Enabled Smart Planning: Setzen Sie sich für die Einführung und Integration von KI und fortschrittlicher Datenanalyse in unsere Planungsprozesse ein, um eine intelligente Planung zu ermöglichen, den Bestandsfluss zu optimieren und die Fähigkeit zur vorausschauenden Entscheidungsfindung in der gesamten Region zu verbessern.

• Team Leadership & Upskilling: Verwalten, beraten und inspirieren Sie direkt ein leistungsstarkes Team von Merchandising Planning Leads und fördern Sie eine Kultur der datengesteuerten Rechenschaftspflicht und operativen Exzellenz.

Deine Geschichte

• 8+ Jahre fortschrittliche Führungserfahrung in der Warenplanung, -prognose oder -strategie, vorzugsweise in der Schuh-, Sportbekleidungs- oder Modebranche.

• Starker technischer Scharfsinn mit einem tiefen Verständnis der Datenarchitektur und praktischer Erfahrung durch die Nutzung von KI-Planungstools und fortschrittlichen Prognosemodellen, um die Geschäftsergebnisse zu steigern.

• Nachgewiesene Erfolgsbilanz bei der Festlegung komplexer Merchandising-Finanzziele, der Verwaltung von Multi-Channel-Prognoseprozessen und dem Ausgleich von Finanz-, Verbraucher- und operativen Überlegungen auf regionaler Ebene.

• Außergewöhnliches Stakeholder-Management und Executive-Präsenz mit der Fähigkeit, funktionsübergreifende Teams und leitende Führungskräfte global und regional zu beeinflussen.

• Eine unternehmerische Denkweise - Sie navigieren gerne strukturierte und unstrukturierte Planungsherausforderungen, führen Teams durch Mehrdeutigkeiten und handeln autonom, um das Geschäft voranzutreiben.

• Eine positive Einstellung mit herausragenden zwischenmenschlichen und Führungsqualitäten. Fließend in englisch (schriftlich und verbal), mit zusätzlichen sprachen als plus.

Treffen Sie das Team

Sie werden das EMEA Merchandising Planning Team leiten und neben wichtigen Führungsfunktionen in den Bereichen B2B-Vertrieb, eCom und Einzelhandel sowie Nachfrageplanung mit einem klaren Fokus auf Produktlebenszyklus und Rentabilität arbeiten. Insbesondere werden Sie mit den Planungsleitern in regionalen und globalen Teams zusammenarbeiten - Demand Planning, Sales Planning, DtC Buying & Planning und Controlling Teams. Da Ihre Arbeit sehr strategisch und funktionsübergreifend ist, werden Sie auch eng mit unseren globalen Produkt-, Merchandising- und Operations-Teams zusammenarbeiten. Ihr Team besteht aus Planungsleitern und Spezialisten, die sich sowohl auf Schuhe als auch auf Bekleidung konzentrieren.

Was wir anbieten

On ist ein Ort, der sich um Wachstum und Fortschritt dreht. Wir bieten eine Umgebung, die den Menschen die Werkzeuge gibt, sich ganzheitlich zu entwickeln - aktiv zu bleiben, zu lernen, zu erforschen und zu innovieren. Unser unverwechselbarer Ansatz kombiniert eine unterstützende, teamorientierte Atmosphäre mit dem Zugang zu persönlicher Selbstfürsorge für körperliches und geistiges Wohlbefinden, so dass jede Person von ihrem Zweck geleitet wird.

On ist ein Equal Opportunity Arbeitgeber. Wir sind bestrebt, ein faires und integratives Arbeitsumfeld zu schaffen, in dem alle Entscheidungen in Bezug auf Rekrutierung, Förderung und Bindung frei von Diskriminierung sind.
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Bref

En tant que responsable de la planification du commerce EMEA, vous serez le visionnaire stratégique qui dirigera notre fonction de planification du commerce dans toute la région. Vous allez concevoir la stratégie de planification qui alimente notre succès commercial, en assurant que notre vision produit se traduit de façon transparente en plans financiers et d'inventaire axés sur les données, hautement précis et évolutives.
En établissant des cadres de pointe et en tirant parti des technologies de pointe, vous donnerez à votre équipe, y compris les responsables de la planification des marchandises, les moyens de stimuler l'excellence opérationnelle. Vous êtes un partenaire de leadership clé, intégrant des idées de planification dans la stratégie plus large de Go-To-Market (GTM) pour combler l'écart entre l'intention de produit mondial et la réalité du marché régional, et pour aligner notre exécution multicanal sur le commerce de gros, le numérique et le commerce de détail.

Votre mission

• Leadership intersectoriel des intervenants : Diriger et gérer les relations interfonctionnelles des intervenants, en tant que partenaire stratégique clé pour canaliser les dirigeants et les chefs de la planification des ventes dans l'ensemble du commerce de gros, du DtC-Ecom et du DtC-Retail afin d'assurer une exécution commerciale unifiée et une planification de bout en bout.

• Cadres stratégiques : Établir le cadre général et définir les façons de travailler pour la planification du niveau de produit dans le plan à longue distance (PRL), la planification avant la saison et la gestion en saison et le cycle PCI, en assurant des prévisions robustes en temps réel aux niveaux vertical, de collecte et de franchise de produits.

• Optimisation des prévisions : Augmenter la précision des prévisions et minimiser les occasions de vente manquées. Vous y arriverez en traduisant intelligemment et rapidement les tendances de vente et les perspectives du marché en ajustements dynamiques des plans et des prévisions ouvertes à l'achat.

• Planification intelligente adaptée à l'IA : Championne de l'adoption et de l'intégration de l'IA et de l'analyse avancée des données dans nos processus de planification afin de permettre une planification intelligente, d'optimiser le flux d'inventaire et d'améliorer les capacités de prise de décisions prédictives dans toute la région.

• Leadership et perfectionnement de l'équipe : Dirigez, mentorez et inspirez directement une équipe hautement performante de responsables de la planification des marchandises, favorisant une culture de responsabilité axée sur les données et d'excellence opérationnelle.

Votre histoire

• 8 ans et plus d'expérience de leadership progressif dans la planification, la prévision ou la stratégie commerciale des marchandises, de préférence dans les industries de la chaussure, du sport ou de la mode.

• Forte acuité technique, avec une compréhension approfondie de l'architecture des données et de l'expérience pratique en tirant parti des outils de planification de l'IA et des modèles avancés de prévision pour produire des résultats commerciaux.

• Expérience éprouvée de la définition d'objectifs financiers complexes de merchandising, de la gestion de processus de prévision multicanaux et de l'équilibre des considérations financières, de consommation et opérationnelles à l'échelle régionale.

• Une présence exceptionnelle de la direction et des parties prenantes, avec la capacité d'influencer les équipes interfonctionnelles et les cadres supérieurs aux niveaux mondial et régional.

• Un état d'esprit entrepreneurial - vous êtes à l'aise de naviguer des défis de planification structurés et non structurés, de diriger des équipes par l'ambiguïté et d'agir de manière autonome pour faire avancer l'entreprise.

• Une attitude positive avec des compétences interpersonnelles et de leadership exceptionnelles. Fluent en anglais (écrit et verbal), avec d'autres langues considérées comme un plus.

Rencontrez l'équipe

Vous dirigerez l'équipe de planification des marchandises de l'EMEA et travaillerez aux côtés des principales fonctions de direction dans les domaines des ventes, du commerce électronique et du commerce de détail, et de la planification de la demande, en mettant clairement l'accent sur le cycle de vie et la rentabilité des produits. En particulier, vous travaillerez en partenariat avec les responsables de la planification des équipes régionales et mondiales - planification de la demande, planification des ventes, achats et planification DtC, et équipes de contrôle. Comme votre travail est hautement stratégique et interfonctionnel, vous travaillerez en étroite collaboration avec nos équipes Global Product, Merchandising et Operations. Votre équipe sera composée de chefs de file et de spécialistes de la planification axés sur les chaussures et les vêtements.

Ce que nous offrons

Sur est un endroit qui est centré sur la croissance et le progrès. Nous offrons un environnement conçu pour donner aux gens les outils pour se développer de manière holistique – rester actifs, apprendre, explorer et innover. Notre approche particulière combine une atmosphère de soutien et d'équipe, avec l'accès à des soins personnels pour le bien-être physique et mental, de sorte que chaque personne est dirigée par but.

Il y a un employeur à égalité de chances. Nous sommes déterminés à créer un milieu de travail équitable et inclusif, où toutes les décisions relatives au recrutement, à l'avancement et au maintien en poste sont exemptes de discrimination.

jobs.title: Head of Functional Communications
jobs.description:
In short:

We are looking for a seasoned internal comms expert with direct experience in leading strategic communications and standing up business partnership models to serve internal functions - including deskless audiences.

Reporting to the Global Head of Internal Communications, the Head of Functional Communications will partner with regional and functional leaders across the business to build team culture and disseminate important information. Whether capturing stories about our culture or helping teams navigate change, this leader will drive impactful communication strategies from start to finish.

This role will be highly embedded in On’s unique and entrepreneurial culture; collaborating with multiple teams to optimize information flow and bring great messages to life.

Your mission:

• Writing messages for global audiences on key topics related to our strategy and culture.

• Co-leading On’s approach to change and crisis management, and how big messages make their way into teams’ daily activities.

• Developing a sub-audience approach that uniquely serves the needs of our store population, regional teams, and leadership layers.

• Leading executive communications for key leaders at On across business functions, including live speaking moments and written messages.

Your story:

In addition to a specific passion for internal communication and culture, we hope you’ll also bring:

• 10+ years of experience working in creative and multi-disciplinary roles across Communications, Change Management, Marketing, Journalism, or a related field.

• Strong writing skills. No matter the subject, you are able to easily identify a story and bring it to life in a clear and compelling way – through talking points, slides, videos, and other mediums.

• Thought leadership. You bring big ideas - and the strategic acumen to actually make them happen. You are skilled at translating your vision into words; bringing peers and stakeholders on board.Executive experience. You have extensive experience working with senior leaders and have played a central role in building executive personas.

• Team leadership. You are a passionate people leader, accustomed with charting growth paths and strategic vision for the team members you support.

• Creativity. Ideally, you bring expertise in at least one relevant audiovisual format (video, audio, graphic design, animation) and find energy in a brainstorming session.

• Collaborative mindset. You enjoy leading large, cross-functional projects and tackling ambiguity with organization.

• Tons of motivation. You are a self-starter; skilled at proactively pitching ideas and getting them off the ground. You’re always picking up new skills and happy to operate in the weeds.

• Industry knowledge. You regularly follow media trends and are highly analytical; able to learn systems easily; identify gaps; and problem solve accordingly. Experience using Slack and G-Suite apps is a plus.

• English fluency. Additional languages are a plus.

Your Team:

This role sits within Internal Communications – a team focused on driving connection and clarity across our global team at On. We’re big thinkers and change-makers, constantly looking for new ways to inform and inspire. If you’re passionate about impacting culture and applying your creativity in various areas of the business, you’ll be in great company.

descriptionByLocale.it:

Segnalandosi al Global Head of Internal Communications, il Head of Functional Communications sarà partner di leader regionali e funzionali in tutto il business per costruire la cultura del team e diffondere informazioni importanti. Questo ruolo sarà fortemente incorporato nella cultura unica e imprenditoriale di On; collaborando con più team per ottimizzare il flusso di informazioni e portare grandi messaggi alla vita.

La vostra missione:

• Co-leader Approccio al cambiamento e alla gestione delle crisi, e come i grandi messaggi fanno la loro strada nelle attività quotidiane delle squadre.

• Sviluppare un approccio sub-audience che serve in modo unico le esigenze della nostra popolazione di negozio, team regionali e livelli di leadership.

• Le principali comunicazioni esecutive per i leader chiave in On attraverso le funzioni aziendali, compresi i momenti di conversazione dal vivo e messaggi scritti.

La tua storia:

Oltre ad una specifica passione per la comunicazione interna e la cultura, speriamo che porti anche:

• 10+ anni di esperienza lavorando in ruoli creativi e multi-disciplinari in Comunicazione, Gestione dei Cambiamenti, Marketing, Giornalismo, o in un campo correlato.

• Forte capacità di scrittura. Non importa il soggetto, si è in grado di identificare facilmente una storia e portarla in un modo chiaro e convincente – attraverso punti di conversazione, diapositive, video e altri mezzi.

• Ho pensato alla leadership. Porti grandi idee - e l'acume strategico per farli realmente accadere. Sei abile nel tradurre la tua visione in parole; portare colleghi e stakeholder a bordo. Esperienza executive. Hai una vasta esperienza di lavoro con i leader senior e hanno svolto un ruolo centrale nella costruzione di personalità esecutive.

• Leader del team. Sei un leader di persone appassionate, abituato a tracciare percorsi di crescita e visione strategica per i membri del team che supporti.

• Creatività. Idealmente, si porta esperienza in almeno un formato audiovisivo rilevante (video, audio, grafica, animazione) e trovare energia in una sessione di brainstorming.

• La mentalità collaborativa. Ti piace progetti di grandi dimensioni, interfunzionali e affrontare l'ambiguità con l'organizzazione.

• Tonnellate di motivazione. Sei un auto-starter; esperto in proattivamente lanciare idee e toglierli dal terreno. Stai sempre raccogliendo nuove competenze e felice di operare nelle erbacce.

• Conoscenza del settore. Si seguono regolarmente le tendenze dei media e sono altamente analitiche; in grado di imparare i sistemi facilmente; identificare le lacune; e il problema risolvere di conseguenza. L'esperienza utilizzando app Slack e G-Suite è un vantaggio.

• Fluente inglese. Le lingue aggiuntive sono un plus.

Il vostro team:

Questo ruolo si trova all'interno delle comunicazioni interne – un team focalizzato sulla connessione di guida e la chiarezza attraverso il nostro team globale in On. Siamo grandi pensatori e produttori di cambiamento, costantemente alla ricerca di nuovi modi per informare e ispirare. descriptionByLocale.en:
In short:

We are looking for a seasoned internal comms expert with direct experience in leading strategic communications and standing up business partnership models to serve internal functions - including deskless audiences.

Reporting to the Global Head of Internal Communications, the Head of Functional Communications will partner with regional and functional leaders across the business to build team culture and disseminate important information. Whether capturing stories about our culture or helping teams navigate change, this leader will drive impactful communication strategies from start to finish.

This role will be highly embedded in On’s unique and entrepreneurial culture; collaborating with multiple teams to optimize information flow and bring great messages to life.

Your mission:

• Writing messages for global audiences on key topics related to our strategy and culture.

• Co-leading On’s approach to change and crisis management, and how big messages make their way into teams’ daily activities.

• Developing a sub-audience approach that uniquely serves the needs of our store population, regional teams, and leadership layers.

• Leading executive communications for key leaders at On across business functions, including live speaking moments and written messages.

Your story:

In addition to a specific passion for internal communication and culture, we hope you’ll also bring:

• 10+ years of experience working in creative and multi-disciplinary roles across Communications, Change Management, Marketing, Journalism, or a related field.

• Strong writing skills. No matter the subject, you are able to easily identify a story and bring it to life in a clear and compelling way – through talking points, slides, videos, and other mediums.

• Thought leadership. You bring big ideas - and the strategic acumen to actually make them happen. You are skilled at translating your vision into words; bringing peers and stakeholders on board.Executive experience. You have extensive experience working with senior leaders and have played a central role in building executive personas.

• Team leadership. You are a passionate people leader, accustomed with charting growth paths and strategic vision for the team members you support.

• Creativity. Ideally, you bring expertise in at least one relevant audiovisual format (video, audio, graphic design, animation) and find energy in a brainstorming session.

• Collaborative mindset. You enjoy leading large, cross-functional projects and tackling ambiguity with organization.

• Tons of motivation. You are a self-starter; skilled at proactively pitching ideas and getting them off the ground. You’re always picking up new skills and happy to operate in the weeds.

• Industry knowledge. You regularly follow media trends and are highly analytical; able to learn systems easily; identify gaps; and problem solve accordingly. Experience using Slack and G-Suite apps is a plus.

• English fluency. Additional languages are a plus.

Your Team:

This role sits within Internal Communications – a team focused on driving connection and clarity across our global team at On. We’re big thinkers and change-makers, constantly looking for new ways to inform and inspire. If you’re passionate about impacting culture and applying your creativity in various areas of the business, you’ll be in great company.
descriptionByLocale.de:
Kurzum:

Wir suchen einen erfahrenen internen Comms-Experten mit direkter Erfahrung in der Führung der strategischen Kommunikation und dem Aufstehen von Business-Partnership-Modellen für interne Funktionen - einschließlich deskless-Publikums.

Der Leiter der funktionalen Kommunikation wird dem Global Head of Internal Communications als Partner mit regionalen und funktionalen Führungskräften im gesamten Unternehmen zusammenarbeiten, um die Teamkultur aufzubauen und wichtige Informationen zu verbreiten. Ob es darum geht, Geschichten über unsere Kultur zu erfassen oder Teams dabei zu helfen, Veränderungen zu bewältigen, diese Führungskraft wird wirkungsvolle Kommunikationsstrategien von Anfang bis Ende vorantreiben.

Diese Rolle wird stark in die einzigartige und unternehmerische Kultur von On eingebettet sein: die Zusammenarbeit mit mehreren Teams, um den Informationsfluss zu optimieren und großartige Botschaften zum Leben zu erwecken.

Ihre Mission:

• Schreiben von Botschaften für ein globales Publikum zu Schlüsselthemen im Zusammenhang mit unserer Strategie und Kultur.

• Co-Leading Ons Ansatz für Veränderung und Krisenmanagement und wie große Botschaften in die täglichen Aktivitäten der Teams gelangen.

• Entwicklung eines Sub-Publikums-Ansatzes, der auf einzigartige Weise den Bedürfnissen unserer Filialbevölkerung, regionaler Teams und Führungsebenen gerecht wird.

• Führende Führungskräftekommunikation für wichtige Führungskräfte bei On in allen Geschäftsfunktionen, einschließlich Live-Sprachmomenten und schriftlichen Nachrichten.

Neben einer besonderen Leidenschaft für interne Kommunikation und Kultur hoffen wir, dass Sie auch Folgendes mitbringen:

descriptionByLocale.fr:
Bref:

Nous sommes à la recherche d'un expert chevronné en communications internes ayant une expérience directe dans la direction des communications stratégiques et le maintien de modèles de partenariat d'affaires pour servir les fonctions internes - y compris les publics sans bureau.

Relevant du chef mondial des communications internes, le chef des communications fonctionnelles s'associera à des dirigeants régionaux et fonctionnels dans l'ensemble de l'entreprise pour développer la culture d'équipe et diffuser des informations importantes. Que ce soit en capturant des histoires sur notre culture ou en aidant les équipes à naviguer dans le changement, ce chef de file mènera des stratégies de communication efficaces du début à la fin.

Ce rôle sera fortement ancré dans la culture unique et entrepreneuriale d'On. Collaborer avec plusieurs équipes pour optimiser la circulation de l'information et donner vie à de grands messages.

Votre mission :

• Écrire des messages pour le public mondial sur des sujets clés liés à notre stratégie et à notre culture.

• Codirigeant Sur l'approche du changement et de la gestion des crises, et comment les grands messages font leur place dans les activités quotidiennes des équipes.

• Développer une approche de sous-audience qui répond de façon unique aux besoins de notre population de magasins, des équipes régionales et des niveaux de leadership.

• Diriger les communications de la haute direction pour les principaux dirigeants de On dans toutes les fonctions opérationnelles, y compris les moments de parole en direct et les messages écrits.

Votre histoire :

En plus d'une passion spécifique pour la communication interne et la culture, nous espérons que vous apporterez également:

• 10 ans et plus d'expérience dans des rôles créatifs et multidisciplinaires à travers les communications, la gestion du changement, le marketing, le journalisme ou un domaine connexe.

• Forte capacité à écrire. Peu importe le sujet, vous êtes en mesure d'identifier facilement une histoire et de la mettre en vie d'une manière claire et convaincante – par des points de discussion, des diapositives, des vidéos et d'autres supports.

• Le leadership de la pensée. Vous apportez de grandes idées - et le sens stratégique pour les faire réellement arriver. Vous êtes habile à traduire votre vision en mots; amener des pairs et des intervenants à bord. Expérience des cadres. Vous avez une vaste expérience de travail avec des cadres supérieurs et avez joué un rôle central dans la création de cadres supérieurs.

• Chef d'équipe. Vous êtes un leader de personnes passionnées, habitué à tracer des trajectoires de croissance et une vision stratégique pour les membres de l'équipe que vous soutenez.

• Créativité. Idéalement, vous apportez une expertise dans au moins un format audiovisuel pertinent (vidéo, audio, graphisme, animation) et trouvez de l'énergie dans une séance de remue-méninges.

• Un état d'esprit collaboratif. Vous aimez diriger de grands projets interfonctionnels et aborder l'ambiguïté avec l'organisation.

• Des tonnes de motivation. Vous êtes un auto-démarrage; compétent pour lancer des idées proactives et les faire sortir du terrain. Vous êtes toujours en train d'acquérir de nouvelles compétences et heureux d'opérer dans les mauvaises herbes.

• Connaissance de l'industrie. Vous suivez régulièrement les tendances des médias et êtes très analytique, capable d'apprendre facilement les systèmes, d'identifier les lacunes et de résoudre les problèmes en conséquence. Expérience avec les applications Slack et G-Suite est un plus.

• La maîtrise de l'anglais. Les langues supplémentaires sont un plus.

Votre équipe :

Ce rôle fait partie des Communications internes – une équipe axée sur la communication et la clarté au sein de notre équipe mondiale à On. Nous sommes de grands penseurs et de changements, constamment à la recherche de nouvelles façons d'informer et d'inspirer. Si vous êtes passionné par l'impact de la culture et l'application de votre créativité dans différents domaines de l'entreprise, vous serez en grande entreprise.

jobs.title: Head of Business Process Excellence

titleByLocale.fr: Chef de l'excellence des processus opérationnels

jobs.description:
In short:

The global Operational Excellence team is looking for a Head of Business Process Excellence to lead our Idea-to-Product domain and Business Architecture team. We are seeking a visionary, data-driven leader to revolutionize our Creation processes. In this role, you will define next-generation digital capabilities - including advanced AI integration- while continuously optimizing our current workflows. You will lead a newly formed team of 5-7, acting as the primary business owner and strategic sparring partner for the Senior Leadership Team to drive operational excellence and chart our digital future. The Head of Business Process Excellence will report to the Senior Director for Operational Excellence, supporting Product Strategy, Innovation, Design, Development and Sourcing teams across Apparel & Accessories (A&A), and Footwear (FTW).

Your Mission:

• Vision & Roadmap Development: Shape the future of our Idea-to-Product organization by defining and executing a long-term vision for our business processes, workflows, and digital capabilities. Act as the resident expert and visionary for integrating AI opportunities throughout the value chain.

• Process Optimization & Digital Twin: Document current workflows and processes to identify optimization potential, while developing the "Northstar" setup for the future way of working across Apparel & Accessories (A&A) and Footwear (FTW).

• Tech Partnership & Capability Delivery: Partner closely with the Technology team as the primary business owner and thought partner to design, gather requirements and align advanced business capabilities with strategic goals.

• Operational Leadership & Decision Making: Act as the primary spokesperson for operational teams, taking critical trade-off decisions, managing the user base, and heading up a dedicated team covering the Idea-to-Product domain.

• Business Architecture: Lead the business architecture team, taking end-to-end responsibility for mapping, scaling, and structuring organizational capabilities.

• Stakeholder Engagement & Sparring: Manage high-level senior interactions and act as a trusted strategic sparring partner for the Senior Leadership Team across Product Strategy, Innovation, Design, Development, and Sourcing teams.

• Enablement & Tool Adoption: Coordinate comprehensive training programs for new tools and capabilities, actively driving user adoption and operational excellence across teams.

Your Story:

• Proven Leadership Experience: 10+ years of experience in business process management, digital transformation, or operational excellence, with a proven track record of managing and developing high-performing teams, with experience managing 5+ direct reports preferred.

• Team Architecture & Talent Leadership: Demonstrated success in the strategic recruitment and development of top-tier talent to build high-performing organizational units from scratch.

• Domain Expertise: Deep understanding of the product development value chain (Idea-to-Product) and Creation processes, preferably within the Apparel, Accessories, or Footwear industries.

• Tech & AI saviness: Technical affinity and a data-informed, problem-solving mindset, backed by deep business acumen and process expertise to help shape technology roadmaps and evaluate AI opportunities.

• Strategic Stakeholder Management: Exceptional communication and interpersonal skills, with demonstrated experience influencing, collaborating with, and acting as a peer to C-suite and Senior Leadership Teams.

• Change Management & Execution: Demonstrated capability in documenting complex workflows, executing gap analyses, driving tool adoption, and managing large-scale user training across cross-functional teams.

• Academic Background: Degree or deep knowledge in Business Administration, Engineering, Operations Management, or a related field with a strong focus on process mapping and capability maturity frameworks.

Attributes of a successful candidate:

• Strategic Visionary: Ability to look past current constraints to design a digital "Northstar," for our future way of doing business, balanced with a pragmatic approach

• Resilient Decision Maker: Comfortable navigating ambiguity, prioritizing conflicting demands, and making high-stakes trade-off decisions in a fast-paced environment.

• Collaborative Influencer: A natural bridge-builder who can seamlessly speak the language of both deep-tech engineers and creative product operations teams.

Your Team:

As the Business Process Excellence team for the Idea-to-Product value stream, we define, manage, and optimize the workflows and technical capabilities that bring our innovative products to life. We are visionaries who are data-driven, action-oriented, and obsessed with challenging the status quo.

Heading up a team of 5-7 domain experts, we work hand-in-hand with Product Strategy, Innovation, Design, Development, Sourcing, and Technology teams to champion future ways of working - ensuring our global growth is supported by cutting-edge AI, digital twins, and operational excellence.

descriptionByLocale.it:
In breve: Il team di Eccellenza Operativa Globale sta cercando un Head of Business Process Excellence per guidare il nostro dominio Idea-to-Product e Business Architecture team. Stiamo cercando un leader visionario e guidato dai dati per rivoluzionare i nostri processi di Creazione. In questo ruolo, definirete le capacità digitali di nuova generazione - inclusa l'integrazione AI avanzata- ottimizzando continuamente i nostri flussi di lavoro attuali. Condurrai un nuovo team di 5-7, che fungerà da primario proprietario di business e partner strategico per il Senior Leadership Team per guidare l'eccellenza operativa e tracciare il nostro futuro digitale. Il Capo di Business Process Excellence si riferirà al Senior Director for Operational Excellence, supportando i team di Product Strategy, Innovation, Design, Development and Sourcing attraverso Apparel & Accessories (A&A), e Footwear (FTW). La vostra missione:
• Vision & Roadmap Development: Forma il futuro della nostra organizzazione Idea-to-Product definendo ed eseguendo una visione a lungo termine per i nostri processi aziendali, flussi di lavoro e capacità digitali. Agire come esperto residente e visionario per integrare le opportunità AI in tutta la catena di valore.
• Ottimizzazione del processo & Digital Twin: Flussi di lavoro e processi attuali del documento per identificare il potenziale di ottimizzazione, sviluppando la configurazione "Northstar" per il futuro modo di lavorare attraverso Apparel & Accessories (A&A) e Footwear (FTW).
• Tech Partnership & Capability Delivery: Partner a stretto contatto con il team tecnologico come principale proprietario di business e partner di pensiero per progettare, raccogliere i requisiti e allineare le capacità aziendali avanzate con obiettivi strategici.
• Leadership operativa & Decision Making: Agire come portavoce primario per i team operativi, prendere decisioni di trade-off critiche, gestire la base utente e dirigere un team dedicato che copre il dominio Idea-to-Product.
• Architettura aziendale: guidare il team di architettura aziendale, assumendo la responsabilità end-to-end per mappare, scalare e strutturare le capacità organizzative.
• Stakeholder Engagement & Sparring: Gestisci le interazioni senior di alto livello e funge da partner strategico di risparmio affidabile per il Senior Leadership Team tra i team di strategia del prodotto, innovazione, design, sviluppo e sourcing.
• Abilitazione & Tool Adoption: Coordinate programmi di formazione completi per nuovi strumenti e funzionalità, guidando attivamente l'adozione degli utenti e l'eccellenza operativa in team. La tua storia:
• Provata esperienza di Leadership: 10+ anni di esperienza nella gestione dei processi aziendali, nella trasformazione digitale o nell'eccellenza operativa, con un comprovato record di gestione e sviluppo di team di alto rendimento, con esperienza di gestione 5+ rapporti diretti preferiti.
• Team Architecture & Talent Leadership: successo dimostrativo nel reclutamento strategico e nello sviluppo di talenti di alto livello per costruire unità organizzative ad alto rendimento da zero.
• Competenza di dominio: profonda comprensione della catena del valore di sviluppo del prodotto (Idea-to-Product) e processi di creazione, preferibilmente all'interno delle industrie Apparel, Accessori o Footwear.
• Tech & AI saviness: affinità tecnica e una mentalità informatizzata, problem-solving, sostenuta da un profondo acum aziendale e competenze di processo per aiutare a modellare le roadmap tecnologiche e valutare le opportunità AI.
• Strategic Stakeholder Management: comunicazione eccezionale e competenze interpersonali, con esperienza dimostrata influenzando, collaborando e agendo come pari a C-suite e Senior Leadership Teams.
• Change Management & Execution: Capacità dimostrata nel documentare flussi di lavoro complessi, eseguire analisi di gap, adottare gli strumenti di guida e gestire la formazione degli utenti su larga scala attraverso team interfunzionali.
• Sfondo accademico: laurea o profonda conoscenza in Business Administration, ingegneria, gestione delle operazioni, o un campo correlato con un forte focus sulla mappatura dei processi e la maturità delle capacità. Attributi di un candidato di successo:
• Strategic Visionary: Capacità di guardare oltre i vincoli attuali per progettare un digitale "Northstar", per il nostro futuro modo di fare business, equilibrato con un approccio pragmatico
• Resilient Decision Maker: Comoda ambiguità di navigazione, priorità richieste contrastanti, e prendere decisioni di scambio ad alto livello in un ambiente veloce.
• Influencer collaborativo: un costruttore di ponti naturali che può parlare senza soluzione di continuità il linguaggio di ingegneri e team di gestione dei prodotti creativi. Il vostro team: Come team di Business Process Excellence per il flusso di valore Idea-to-Product, definiamo, gestiamo e ottimizzamo i flussi di lavoro e le capacità tecniche che portano alla vita i nostri prodotti innovativi. Siamo visionari che sono data-driven, orientati all'azione, e ossessionati dal sfidare lo status quo. Dirigendo un team di 5-7 esperti di dominio, lavoriamo a stretto contatto con i team di Product Strategy, Innovation, Design, Development, Sourcing e Technology per sostenere le future modalità di lavoro, garantendo che la nostra crescita globale sia supportata da AI all'avanguardia, gemelli digitali e eccellenza operativa.

• Strategisches Stakeholder-Management: Außergewöhnliche Kommunikation und zwischenmenschliche Fähigkeiten mit nachgewiesener Erfahrung, die C-Suite und Senior Leadership Teams beeinflussen, mit ihnen zusammenarbeiten und als Peer agieren.
• Change Management & Execution: Demonstrierte Fähigkeit zur Dokumentation komplexer Workflows, Durchführung von Lückenanalysen, Einführung von Tools und Verwaltung groß angelegter Benutzerschulungen in funktionsübergreifenden Teams.
• Akademischer Hintergrund: Grad oder tiefe Kenntnisse in Business Administration, Engineering, Operations Management oder einem verwandten Bereich mit einem starken Fokus auf Prozess-Mapping und Fähigkeitsreife Frameworks. Attribute eines erfolgreichen Kandidaten:
• Strategischer Visionär: Die Fähigkeit, die aktuellen Zwänge zu überwinden, um einen digitalen "Northstar" für unsere zukünftige Geschäftsweise zu entwerfen, ausgeglichen mit einem pragmatischen Ansatz
• Resilienter Entscheidungsträger: Komfortables Navigieren von Mehrdeutigkeiten, Priorisierung widersprüchlicher Anforderungen und Treffen von Kompromissentscheidungen mit hohem Einsatz in einer schnelllebigen Umgebung.
• Collaborative Influencer: Ein natürlicher Brückenbauer, der die Sprache von Deep-Tech-Ingenieuren und kreativen Produktbetriebsteams nahtlos sprechen kann. Ihr Team: Als Business Process Excellence Team für den Ideen-zu-Produkt-Wertstrom definieren, verwalten und optimieren wir die Workflows und technischen Fähigkeiten, die unsere innovativen Produkte zum Leben erwecken. Wir sind Visionäre, die datengesteuert, handlungsorientiert und besessen davon sind, den Status quo in Frage zu stellen. Als Leiter eines Teams von 5-7 Fachexperten arbeiten wir Hand in Hand mit Produktstrategie-, Innovations-, Design-, Entwicklungs-, Beschaffungs- und Technologieteams, um zukünftige Arbeitsweisen zu fördern und sicherzustellen, dass unser globales Wachstum durch modernste KI, digitale Zwillinge und operative Exzellenz unterstützt wird.
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Bref: L'équipe mondiale d'excellence opérationnelle est à la recherche d'un chef de l'excellence des processus d'affaires pour diriger notre équipe de domaine Idée à produit et d'architecture d'affaires. Nous cherchons un leader visionnaire et axé sur les données pour révolutionner nos processus de création. Dans ce rôle, vous définirez les capacités numériques de nouvelle génération - y compris l'intégration avancée de l'IA - tout en optimisant continuellement nos flux de travail actuels. Vous dirigerez une équipe nouvellement formée de 5-7, agissant en tant que principal propriétaire d'entreprise et partenaire stratégique de l'équipe de leadership senior pour diriger l'excellence opérationnelle et tracer notre avenir numérique. Le chef de l'excellence des processus opérationnels relèvera du directeur principal de l'excellence opérationnelle, qui appuie les équipes de la Stratégie des produits, de l'innovation, de la conception, du développement et de l'approvisionnement des vêtements et accessoires (A et A) et des chaussures (FTW). Votre mission :
• Développement de la vision et de la feuille de route : façonner l'avenir de notre organisation Idée à produit en définissant et en exécutant une vision à long terme de nos processus d'affaires, de nos flux de travail et de nos capacités numériques. Agir en tant qu'expert résident et visionnaire pour intégrer les possibilités d'IA tout au long de la chaîne de valeur.
• Optimisation des processus & Digital Twin: Documenter les flux de travail et les processus actuels pour identifier le potentiel d'optimisation, tout en développant la configuration "Northstar" pour la manière future de travailler sur les vêtements et accessoires (A&A) et les chaussures (FTW).
• Partenariat technique et prestation des capacités: partenaire en étroite collaboration avec l'équipe Technologie en tant que principal propriétaire d'entreprise et partenaire de pensée pour concevoir, rassembler les exigences et aligner les capacités d'affaires avancées avec les objectifs stratégiques.
• Leadership opérationnel et prise de décision : agir en tant que porte-parole principal des équipes opérationnelles, prendre des décisions de compromis critiques, gérer la base d'utilisateurs et diriger une équipe spécialisée couvrant le domaine Idée à produit.
• Architecture d'affaires : Diriger l'équipe d'architecture d'affaires, assumer la responsabilité de bout en bout de la cartographie, de l'échelle et de la structuration des capacités organisationnelles.
• Engagement des intervenants et partage des responsabilités : Gérer les interactions avec les cadres supérieurs de haut niveau et agir en tant que partenaire stratégique fiable pour l'équipe de leadership senior à l'échelle des équipes de stratégie de produits, d'innovation, de conception, de développement et d'approvisionnement.
• Activement et adoption d'outils : Coordonner des programmes de formation complets pour les nouveaux outils et capacités, en conduisant activement l'adoption des utilisateurs et l'excellence opérationnelle entre les équipes. Votre histoire :
• Expérience de leadership éprouvée : plus de 10 ans d'expérience dans la gestion des processus d'affaires, la transformation numérique ou l'excellence opérationnelle, avec une expérience éprouvée de gestion et de développement d'équipes performantes, avec une expérience de gestion de 5+ rapports directs préférée.
• Architecture d'équipe et leadership des talents : succès démontré dans le recrutement stratégique et le développement de talents de haut niveau pour construire des unités organisationnelles performantes à partir de zéro.
• Domaine Expertise : Compréhension approfondie de la chaîne de valeur du développement de produits (Idée à produit) et des processus de création, de préférence dans les industries du vêtement, des accessoires ou de la chaussure.
• Saviness Tech & AI: affinité technique et un état d'esprit de résolution de problèmes éclairés par les données, soutenu par un sens profond des affaires et une expertise de processus pour aider à façonner les feuilles de route technologiques et évaluer les opportunités d'IA.
• Gestion stratégique des intervenants : Compétences exceptionnelles en communication et en relations interpersonnelles, dont l'expérience a démontré l'influence, la collaboration et le rôle de pair avec les équipes de direction C-suite et senior.
• Gestion et exécution du changement : Capacité démontrée de documenter des workflows complexes, d'effectuer des analyses des lacunes, d'adopter des outils de conduite et de gérer la formation des utilisateurs à grande échelle dans les équipes interfonctionnelles.
• Contexte académique : Degré ou connaissance approfondie en administration des affaires, en génie, en gestion des opérations ou dans un domaine connexe, l'accent étant mis sur la cartographie des processus et les cadres de maturité des capacités. Attributs d'un candidat reçu :
• Visionnaire stratégique : Capacité de regarder au-delà des contraintes actuelles pour concevoir une "Northstar" numérique, pour notre façon de faire future, équilibrée avec une approche pragmatique
• Décideur résilient : ambiguité de navigation confortable, hiérarchisation des demandes conflictuelles, et prise de décisions à haut risque dans un environnement rapide.
• Influenceur collaboratif : Un bridge-builder naturel capable de parler parfaitement le langage des ingénieurs de haute technologie et des équipes d'exploitation de produits créatifs. Votre équipe : En tant qu'équipe d'excellence des processus d'affaires pour le flux de valeur Idée à produit, nous définissons, gérons et optimisons les flux de travail et les capacités techniques qui donnent vie à nos produits innovants. Nous sommes des visionnaires qui sont axés sur les données, orientés vers l'action et obsédés par le statu quo. En tant qu'équipe composée de 5 à 7 experts du domaine, nous travaillons en collaboration avec des équipes de stratégie de produits, d'innovation, de conception, de développement, d'approvisionnement et de technologie afin de défendre les futures façons de travailler, en veillant à ce que notre croissance mondiale soit soutenue par l'IA de pointe, les jumeaux numériques et l'excellence opérationnelle.

jobs.title: Global Head of Marketing Program Management

titleByLocale.en: Global Head of Marketing Program Management

jobs.description:
In short

We are looking for a Global Head of Marketing Program Management to lead our Global Creative Studio’s program and project management teams. You will be the architect of our workflows, bridging the gap between creative ambition and excellence in delivery. This role leads a team of 20 people and is based in Zurich.

Your mission is to ensure the global brand plan is meticulously applied and deployed across all channels with world-class quality and velocity. You will oversee the full project lifecycle, from our major global campaigns to branding projects and e-commerce assets - focusing on seamless execution, timeline adherence, and global scalability.

Your mission

• Strategic Leadership: Lead and mentor a high-performing global team of Program Managers, fostering a culture of accountability and excellence in delivery.

• Studio Collaboration: Partner closely with Creative, Strategy, and Production teams to ensure the right talent is activated at the right time in the project lifecycle for maximum impact and efficiency.

• Global Campaign Delivery: Ensure the end-to-end execution of our major global campaigns across multiple channels, connecting and aligning requirements across different regions.

• Channel & Regional Integration: Partner directly with leaders across Digital, Retail, Social, PR, and Regional hubs to drive project execution and ensure a unified global rollout.

• Studio Project Management: Orchestrate all projects led by the Creative Studio, including branding initiatives, visual identity evolution, and e-commerce asset production.

• Global Delivery Engine: Implement standardized workflows and frameworks to streamline global execution and eliminate friction between departments.

• Financial Oversight: Oversee large-scale marketing budgets at a vertical level, focusing on craft excellence, but also optimization and financial discipline.

Your story

• Experience: 15+ years in Program Management or Marketing Operations within global brands or high-velocity creative environments.

• Execution Track Record: Proven experience delivering complex global campaigns and a wide variety of projects, including brand identity, digital projects, and evergreen assets.

• Expertise: Deep understanding of creative processes, production lifecycles, and marketing ecosystems.

• Systems Thinking: Ability to structure complex environments and implement enterprise-level project management methodologies.

• Agility: A professional who remains calm in ambiguity and can pivot instantly in a high-growth environment.

• Executive Presence: Strong communication skills with the ability to influence stakeholders and navigate both creative and business requirements.

Meet the team

On’s Brand Studio is an award-winning internal studio aiming to challenge world-leading creative agencies. At our core, we tell compelling stories and bring experiences to life. We channel the energy and global nature of the brand into our daily work and you can help us continue our fantastic run of successes. If you’re bursting with original ideas and have the drive and experience to see them realized, this is the team for you.

jobs.title: Fit Model (Flexible, Part-Time Opportunity)
jobs.description:
Help Shape the Future of Performance Apparel

Do you have spare time alongside your studies, work, or other commitments and would like to contribute to the development of premium performance apparel?

We're looking for flexible individuals with active lifestyles to join our apparel team as Fit Models. In this role, you'll play an important part in the development and refinement of our products by participating in garment fittings throughout the product creation process.

As a Fit Model, you'll work closely with our Apparel teams, helping us ensure that our products meet the highest standards of fit, comfort, and performance. You will gain exclusive insights into upcoming products and innovations before they reach the market, becoming a trusted partner in an ongoing relationship that could extend over several seasons and years.

Because On creates performance-driven running and training gear, we are looking for people who are active, fit, and comfortable testing garments during activities such as walking or running on a treadmill.

If this sounds like an exciting opportunity for you, or someone you know, we'd love to hear from you.

What You'll Do

• Participate in apparel fitting sessions with our product teams

• Provide feedback on fit, comfort, and functionality

• Test garments during movement-based activities, including treadmill running

• Contribute to the development and refinement of future On products

• Support product teams throughout multiple stages of the design and development process

What We're Looking For

As our products are developed and tested in specific sample sizes, it's important that applicants closely match our measurement requirements and maintain measurements that remain consistent over time.

You should:

• Be based in the Zurich region and able to attend fittings in person

• Be flexible regarding appointment scheduling and session duration

• Be available to attend fitting sessions on at least two weekdays per week, as needed

• Maintain a consistent figure that aligns with our fit model requirements

• Be comfortable participating in movement-based testing activities

How to Apply

Please submit your measurements according to the instructions provided in the application form. Use a tape measure and record all measurements in centimetres.

Application Form: https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSfYxhY8kQxlua6qW0MCpxhyG2eNTbRwW9Ut5_6LfVnEGlseyA/viewform?usp=publish-editor

Additional Information

As a Fit Model, you may be exposed to confidential products and developments. We therefore place great value on professionalism, discretion, and trust.

Please note that due to the specific measurement requirements of this role, only applicants who meet the fit model criteria will be contacted.

What we offer

On is a place that is centered around growth and progress. We offer an environment designed to give people the tools to develop holistically – to stay active, to learn, explore and innovate. Our distinctive approach combines a supportive, team-oriented atmosphere, with access to personal self-care for both physical and mental well-being, so each person is led by purpose.

On is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to creating a work environment that is fair and inclusive, where all decisions related to recruitment, advancement, and retention are free of discrimination.

jobs.title: Director of Product Testing
jobs.description:
In Short:

At On, we are obsessed with empowering human movement and delivering an unparalleled performance and sensory experience. We are seeking a visionary Director of Product Testing to lead the evolution of our lab, transforming it from a traditional mechanical testing center into a world-class hub for dynamic, consumer-centric, and subjective product validation. This is a pivotal leadership role designed to infuse the voice of the athlete and the psychology of the consumer into the heart of our product creation engine, ensuring every On product delivers on its promise of Swiss Engineering.

Your Mission:

As the Director of Product Testing, you will be the architect of our future testing strategy. You will lead a talented team of technical experts, guiding them beyond the 'what' of objective durability to the 'why' of subjective feel, comfort, and performance. You will build and manage a new, independent lab function focused on fit, wear, and innovation, creating the methodologies and environment necessary to capture honest, actionable consumer insights. Your leadership will be instrumental in shifting our quality paradigm from reactionary analysis to preventative excellence, embedding quality and consumer obsession at the very beginning of the product lifecycle.

Key Responsibilities

• Strategic Leadership: Develop and execute a forward-thinking strategy for product testing that prioritizes subjective, consumer-focused feedback and psychological insights over traditional, objective mechanical testing.

• Team Development & Mentorship: Lead, inspire, and upskill a team of technical testing experts. Foster a culture of trust, stability, and high performance, coaching the team in the principles of consumer psychology and sensory analysis.

• Methodology Innovation: Design and implement novel testing frameworks, including dynamic focus groups and A/B testing protocols, to scientifically evaluate subjective product attributes like comfort, fit, and the feeling of speed.

• Organizational Management & Alignment: Provide unified leadership and strategic direction to our global Product Testing organization. You will manage and align our geographically distributed teams, including the durability and fit team based in Asia and the consumer-centric testing team in Zurich. Your role is to harmonize these functions, ensuring our foundational durability and fit standards are seamlessly integrated with the advanced athlete and consumer insights gathered from Zurich's dynamic focus groups.

• Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner closely with Product Development, Design, Quality Engineering, and Strategy teams to ensure testing insights are integrated early in the design and manufacturing process, preventing issues before they arise.

• Technological Advancement: Champion the use of new technologies, including AI and automation, to empower the team, streamline processes, and free up resources for more in-field, human-centric testing.

• Insight Synthesis: Translate complex quantitative and qualitative data into a clear, compelling narrative that informs critical product decisions and reinforces our commitment to premium, consumer-obsessed products.

Your Story:

• A World-Class People Leader: You are a fantastic and experienced leader, known for your ability to cultivate trust, manage down effectively, and develop the "superpowers" of your team members. Your primary passion is leading people, not just processes.

• Consumer-Obsessed: You have a deep-seated curiosity about consumer behavior and are driven to understand the psychology behind their decisions and perceptions. You naturally put the consumer at the center of every decision.

• A Strategic Thinker with an Explorer's Spirit: You are not a traditional technical tester. You have a background that allows you to approach testing in a new light, with an entrepreneurial mindset to challenge the status quo and explore new frontiers in product validation.

• Psychologically Astute: You have a strong interest or formal background in psychology, consumer science, or a related field, enabling you to build a scientifically rigorous approach to subjective testing.

• An Exceptional Communicator: You possess strong communication skills, capable of articulating a clear vision and providing candid, constructive feedback to your team and stakeholders.

Qualifications

• Proven experience in a senior leadership role, with a strong track record of building and developing high-performing teams.

• Experience in a consumer-facing industry is essential; a background in sporting goods (footwear, apparel, accessories), consumer electronics, or other premium product categories is highly preferred.

• Demonstrated ability to lead through organizational change and transition.

• While not mandatory, a degree or advanced studies in Psychology, Kinesiology, Human Factors, or a related field is a significant asset.

• Passion for sport, movement, and the On brand.

Your Team:

You'll be a leader in a global team fueled by a culture of relentless discovery. We test and validate our product promises, transforming athlete feedback and scientific data into market-leading performance. While our creation partners work to make products great, our mission is to prove they're great. Based in Zurich, our team is the ultimate destination for individuals dedicated to enhancing the consumer experience.

On is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to creating a work environment that is fair and inclusive, where all decisions related to recruitment, advancement, and retention are free of discrimination.

jobs.title: Head of Membership
jobs.description:
Head of Membership

Reports To: Director of CRM and Loyalty

Vision

At On, we believe in the power of movement and community; our membership program is the connective thread across our brand and commercial touchpoints, allowing us to identify and reward our most loyal customers, inspire them to move, and offer them the very best of On.

The Head of Membership will play a critical role in scaling our membership program to ensure it continues to support our overarching business strategy and drive long term impact. Nurturing Customer Loyalty is absolutely crucial to achieving our Long-Range Plan (LRP) ambitions, making this role central to our future growth.

Key Mission

Your mission is to build a thriving membership community that drives mutual value for our most loyal customers and our brand, through delivering a premium omnichannel membership program that has the final objective of increasing frequency of purchase and CLV. You will build and scale a rewarding benefits suite that deeply engages our community and drives the company's long-term business goals.

Your Mission

- Champion Membership at On: Serve as the internal voice of the member and the spokesperson for the membership program, ensuring that customer loyalty remains a central focus across business functions.
 - Own the Benefits Suite: Create, manage and drive the yearly calendar of members' activations and benefits, ensuring that there’s always relevant and rewarding benefits that truly fit our brand mission and deliver value to our members.
 - Strategic Leadership: Deliver and iterate on the overarching membership strategy utilizing a test and learn approach to ensure it acts as a key driver for our Long-Range Plan (LRP) and long-term business goals.
 - Drive Scale & Operational Excellence: Oversee the daily operations of the membership program, ensuring we deliver premium omnichannel experiences that bring maximum value to our community and business.
 - Personalization & Customer Understanding: Champion personalization initiatives across the membership experience. Leverage data and insights to drive a deep, nuanced understanding of our customers, allowing us to tailor interactions and anticipate their needs.
 - Cross-functional Collaboration: As the key stakeholder to the Digital Loyalty Stream, collaborate closely to identify and deliver the experiences that bring the membership program to life across channels. Spearhead cross-functional collaboration across the rest of the business to deliver on the strategy and drive results, working closely with Digital, Commercial, Product, Retail, Events, and Marketing teams.

Your Story

- Experience: 7+ years of progressive experience in strategic planning, marketing, or a related field, with a demonstrated focus on customer-centric strategies.
 - Specialization: 3+ years of dedicated experience building, managing, or optimizing Loyalty or Membership programs on a global or large-scale level.
 - Leadership: Proven team leadership and change management skills, with the ability to inspire cross-functional teams and drive alignment towards a shared vision.
 - Customer-Obsessed: Deeply passionate about understanding consumer behavior, with a strong background in leveraging insights to create highly personalized customer journeys.
 - Strategic Thinker: Ability to connect daily operational initiatives to long-term business ambitions, specifically within the context of long-range corporate planning.

Meet the Team

We aren't just managing a database; we are building a global movement. The CRM and Loyalty team sits at the intersection of data, culture, and community, serving as the bridge between On’s physical running hubs and our digital ecosystem.

We are a collaborative, customer-obsessed powerhouse, partnering daily with Digital, Retail, and Marketing to turn casual runners into lifelong fans. We thrive on a "test-and-learn" mentality, treating our goals with the spirit of a high-performing sports team. Here, you'll lead the charge, shaping a premium experience that inspires our global community to keep moving.

What We Offer

On is a place that is centered around growth and progress. We offer an environment designed to give people the tools to develop holistically – to stay active, to learn, explore and innovate. Our distinctive approach combines a supportive, team-oriented atmosphere, with access to personal self-care for both physical and mental well-being, so each person is led by purpose.

On is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to creating a work environment that is fair and inclusive, where all decisions related to recruitment, advancement, and retention are free of discrimination.
